v: Ha t'a yol smakb'en Uz ek'nak jun winh winak skuchan Job. Te tojol spensar winh, te wach' sb'eyb'al winh, te ay yelk'och Dios t'a sat winh. Sya'ilej wal sb'a winh, max yak'och sb'a winh t'a skal chukal.
Ha winhaj Job chi' ay ukwanh yuninal winh yet' oxwanh yisil.

Ay 7 mil nok' skalnel winh, 3 mil nok' scamello winh, 500 moj nok' wakax smunlaji yet' 500 nok' b'uru. Manh jantakok heb' schekab' winh. Anhej wal winh te b'eyum t'a yichanh heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh chi', k'ajan heb' winh yoch q'uinh t'a spat junjun. Stzolal yek' q'uinh chi' t'a heb' winh, syawtan heb' ix oxwanh yanab' heb' winh chi' wael yet'ok.

Ayik slajwi yek'chaj q'uinh chi' t'a heb' winh t'a stzolal, tz'awtajkot heb' winh yuj winhaj Job chi'. Ak'walto sk'e waan winh, snhusan silab' winh yuj junjun heb' winh, yik sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh t'a sat Dios, talaj tz'och smul heb' winh, syalan chuk heb' winh t'a Dios t'a spensar snaan winh. Icha chi' sk'ulej winh t'a juntak el.
Ay jun k'u ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' ángel tz'ak'an serwil Jehová t'a yichanh t'a satcha'anh. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', ix k'ochpax jun ángel ajk'ool, haton winh Satanás.
Ix sk'anb'an Jehová t'a winh Satanás chi' icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ach koti? xchi. Ix yalan winh: --In kot t'a yol yib'anhk'inal, yujto tzek' woymitej lum smasanil, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tzam il tas yaj winh in chekab' aj Job? Malaj junokxo mach t'a yol yib'anhk'inal icha winh chi', te tojol spensar winh, te wach' sb'eyb'al winh, ay welk'och t'a yol sat winh, sya'ilej wal sb'a winh, max yak'och sb'a winh t'a skal chukal, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh Satanás chi' icha tik: --Manh nab'anhejok wach' syutej sb'a winh t'a ichanh.

Yujto max yal a k'ol to ay junok mach tz'ik'anek' junok tas t'a winh, ma tastak ay t'a yol spat winh yet' masanil tastak ay t'a winh. Ha ach tzak'nhej a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh masanil tastak sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' ek'b'al sb'isul nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh yet' sb'eyumal.
Palta q'uinalok a tiknaik tzik'ek' masanil tas ay t'a winh chi', ol hilani tato manh ol yal chuk winh t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Ichokab' ta', ol xo ila' tas tza k'ulej yet' masanil tastak ay t'a winh chi', anhej to malaj tas tzutej sniwanil winh, xchi. Ixlajwi chi' ix el winh Satanás chi' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ay jun k'u, ayik wan swa heb' winh yuninal yet' heb' ix yisil winhaj Job chi' t'a spat winh b'ab'el winak,
ix jawi jun winh chekab' b'aj ayek' winhaj Job chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Wan ko munlaj yet' nok' wakax, haxo nok' b'uru wan swa nok' t'a ko lak'anil chi'.
Haxo ix aji, ix jawi heb' winh sabeo, ix miljikancham heb' winh munlajwum chi' yuj heb' winh. Ix yelk'anb'at nok' wakax chi' heb' winh. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.

Manto wal lajwilaj yalan jun winh chi', ix jawi junxo winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ix kot k'ak' t'a satcha'anh yuj Dios, ix cham masanil heb' winh tanhwum kalnel yet' nok' kalnel chi'. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.

Manto wal lajwilaj yalan junxo winh chi', ix jawi junxo winh yoxil, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha heb' winh caldeo, ox makan wal ix aj heb' winh yak'an owal t'ayonh. Ix smilancham masanil heb' winh stanhwan nok' a camello heb' winh, ix yelk'anb'at nok' heb' winh. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.
Manto wal lajwilaj yalan junxo winh chi', ix jawi junxo winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha heb' winh uninal yet' heb' ix isil, wan swa heb', syuk'an wino heb' t'a spat winh b'ab'el uninal,

haxo ix aji, ix jawi jun tzijtumal ik' t'a stojolal lum takinh lu'um. Ix em lanhnaj spat heb' uninal chi' t'a yib'anh yuj jun ik' chi', ix cham heb' smasanil. Ha inxonhej ix yal wel lemnajok yik tzul walan ab'i, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix k'e waan winhaj Job chi', ix te kus winh sik'lab'il. Ix snhik'chitan spichul winh, ix stzukanel xil sjolom winh, ix em nhojan winh ejmelal t'a Dios.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Malaj jab'ok tas wet'nak in alji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, malaj pax jab'ok tas ol wik'b'ati ayik ol in meltzajxok. Ha Jehová ix ak'an masanil tas t'ayin, hanheja' pax tz'ik'anxieq'ui. Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ay, xchi winh.
Wach'chom niwan yaelal ix ek' t'a yib'anh winhaj Job chi', palta maj ochlaj smul winh yujto maj yal-laj chukal winh t'a spatik Dios yuj tas ix utaj chi'.
Ayik ix k'och sk'ual smolb'anxi sb'a heb' ángel tz'ak'an serwil Jehová t'a yichanh, ix k'och pax winh Satanás t'a skal heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an Jehová chi' t'a winh: --¿B'ajtil ach koti? xchi. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ix in kot t'a yol yib'anhk'inal, yujto tzek' woymitej lum smasanil, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: --¿Tzam il tas yaj winh in chekab' aj Job? Malaj wal junokxo mach t'a yol yib'anhk'inal chi' lajan yet' winh. Te tojol spensar winh, te wach' sb'eyb'al winh. Ay wal welk'och t'a yol sat winh, sya'ilej wal sb'a winh, max yak'och sb'a winh t'a skal chukal. Uuj wal ix in satel masanil tastak ay t'a winh, palta tokwal yuj chi' ix juwiel spensar winh, xchi.
Ix tak'wi winh Satanás chi' icha tik: --Tato malaj tz'ik'an sniwanil junok mach, ¿tok ay tas sna'a? B'ekan sk'ol slajwiel masanil tastak ay t'ay yik skolan sk'inal.
Palta tato a tiknaik ha t'a sniwanil winh chi' tzak'och junok yaelal, ol hilani tato manh ol yal chuk winh t'ayach, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a winh: --Ichokab' ta'. Olxo ila' tas tza k'ulej yet' sniwanil winh chi', anhej b'ian to malaj halan ik ik'anel sk'inal winh, xchi.
Ix el winh Satanás chi' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix b'at yak'ank'e juntzanh yab'il winh te niwan t'a sniwanil winhaj Job chi', schakot t'a yok winh masanto t'a sjolom winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at em k'ojan winhaj Job chi' t'a skal k'een tik'aq'uil taanh. Ix yik'ankot jab' sti' lum chen winh, sjotz'anek' lum winh t'ay.
Palta haxo ix yetb'eyum winh ix halan t'ay icha tik: --¿Tom hanheja' wach'nhej tzutej a pensar? Al chuk t'a Dios, tzach cham b'ian, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Ach ix, lajan wal a lolon icha heb' ix ix malaj jab'ok spensar. Toxo ix ko cha swach'k'olal Dios, ¿tom manh ol ko chapax ko yaelal syak'a'? xchi winhaj Job chi'. Yuj chi', wach'chom ayoch syaelal winh, palta maj ochlaj smul winh yujto malaj chuk ix yal winh t'a spatik Dios.

Ay oxwanh heb' winh yamigo winhaj Job chi': Haton winhaj Elifaz aj Temán, winhaj Bildad aj Súa yet' winhaj Zofar aj Naamat. Ayik ix yab'an spekal masanil juntzanh yaelal ix jawi t'a yib'anh winhaj Job chi' heb' winh, ix yak'anoch heb' winh t'a sk'ol skot yak' sniwanil sk'ol winh, yik tzul mol kus pax heb' winh yuj syaelal winh chi'.

Najatto wan skot heb' winh, ix yilankot winhaj Job chi' heb' winh. Pural ix och sat heb' winh t'a winh, yuj chi' ix syamanoch heb' winh yok' yuj winh. Ix te kus heb' winh, ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul heb' winh. Ix stzipanchaanh pokok heb' winh t'a chaanh, haxo t'a sjolom heb' winh tz'em lu'um.

Ix em k'ojan heb' winh t'a sat lum yet' winh, uke' k'ual, uke' ak'wal ix ek' heb' winh yet' winh ta', malaj junok b'elanh lolonel ix yal heb' winh, yujto te ow yak'an syaelal winhaj Job chi' ix yil heb' winh.
Ayik ix lajwiek' juntzanh chi', ix skatab'an winhaj Job chi' jun k'u b'aj aljinak. Ix yalan winh icha tik:
Tzin katab'ej jun ak'wal ayik skuchannak in och ix in nun. Tzin katab'ej jun k'u ayik waljinak.
Komonok a jun k'u chi' och t'ak'walilal. Komonok kannhej icha chi' yuj Dios, maj sakb'ok.
Komonok ay wal junok niwan wewen ochnak, yik wach' k'ik'b'ikaneli. Komonok ay wal junok niwan k'ik' asun musani, ma junok k'ik' och t'a sat k'u, yik ay xiwk'olal t'a jun k'u chi'.
Komonok k'ik' k'inal ajkan jun ak'wal chi', yik wach' maj och jun k'u chi' sb'isulok sk'ual yik jun uj chi' yet' jun ab'il chi'.
Komonok malaj tas uji t'a jun ak'wal chi', yik wach' malaj aw yik tzalajk'olal ochi.
Komonok skatab'aj jun ak'wal chi' yuj heb' ajb'aal, haton heb' syal skuchb'an nok' leviatán.
Komonok maj k'eul k'een niwak k'anal t'a jun q'uinhib'alil chi'. Komonok maj k'eul sakil k'inal stanhwaj sk'euli yet' sakil yich chaanh.
Tzin katab'ej jun ak'wal chi', yujto maj syamoch waan waljub'al. Tato maay, tekan max wil jantak yaelal yet' kusk'olal tik.
Oktom cham in t'a yol sk'ol ix in nun. Oktom cham in ayik wan walji.
Oktom malaj jolom penek chaan in. Oktom malaj im in chu'u yik tzin q'uib'i.
Oktom chamnak in, tzalajk'olal am tzin way tiknaik. Junk'olal am swik' wip
yet' heb' rey yet' heb' yajal, haton heb' ix b'oanxik'e juntzanh niwak pat emnak lanhnajok,
ma yet' heb' niwak yajal b'ut'an spalacio yuj k'een oro yet' k'een plata.
¿Tas yuj maj in mukchaj icha junok unin tonhej tz'eq'ui, ma icha junok unin chamnakxo tz'alji?
Ha b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, hata' slajwikan b'aj syixtej anima heb' chuk. Ha pax ta' syik' yip heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' chi'.
Hata' syik' yip heb' icha preso yaj t'a munlajel, manhxa b'aj syab' heb' stumaj yuj heb' tz'ilan munlajel chi'.
Hata' ayek' heb' niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' malaj yelk'ochi yet' heb' elnakxo t'a yalanh smandar spatrón. Lajanxonhej heb' smasanil.
¿Tas yuj syak' Dios sakil k'inal yil heb' tz'ixtaji? ¿Tas yuj syak' sk'inal heb' ayoch t'a syaelal,
heb' snib'ej cham sb'a, palta max chamlaj heb', wach'chom snib'ej chamel chi' heb' t'a yichanh b'eyumal?
Ha jun anima chi' schax stzalajk'olal yuj ayik toxo ix b'atkan t'a yol b'aj smukchaji.
¿Tas yuj hanheja' yak'an in k 'inal Dios, a in to manh wojtakok tas ol in ajok, a in icha wal to makan in yuj?
Maxtzak yal in wa'i, maxtzak yal pax wuk'an ha' yuj ok'el yuj in yaelal.
Ha tas b'aj swekxiw in b'a, haton sjawi t'a wib'anh.
Maxtzak yal wik'an jab'ok wip, manhxalaj swach'il waji. Manhxa jab'ok in junk'olal, haxonhej yaelal tzin ik'ani, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Elifaz aj Temán t'a winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ach Job, tekan chuk tzab'i tato ay mach stek'b'ej sb'a slolon het'ok, palta maxtzak techaj wuuj tato tonhej swab'i.
Yujto tzijtum mach b'aj ix ak' k'ayb'ub'al, ix ak'an pax stek'anil heb' somchajnakeli.
Ix ak' stek'anil heb' telwinak. Ix a yamanoch waan heb' ay schab'k'olal,
haxo yik ix ja yaelal t'a ib'anh tik, manhxa jab'ok a tek'anil.
Ha ach tik tza k'anab'ajej wal Dios, tojol a b'eyb'al halani. ¿Tas yuj somchajel a k'ol tiknaik?
Nawalkoti, ¿tokwal sjawi yaelal t'a yib'anh heb' malaj smul? ¿Tokwal komon scham heb' wach' sb'eyb'al?
Ha swilani, a heb' sk'ulan chukal, a tas sk'ulej heb' chi' sjawi t'a yib'anh.
Syak'kot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb', satjiel heb' t'a junelnhej yuj, icha tz'aj satjiel tastak yuj chakxuxum ik'.
Tz'el yaw heb' icha yel yaw nok' choj, palta ha Dios tz'ak'an em numan heb', icha yem numan nok' choj smak'jiel ye.
Maxtzak yal-laj swa nok', scham nok' yuj wejel, haxo nok' yunetak, toxonhej saklemkanb'at nok'. Icha chi' tz'aj heb' chuk chi' yuj Dios.
k'unnhej ix k'och jun lolonel ix sajjioch t'a in chikin, pural wal ix wab'i.
Ha t'ak'walil ayik yoralil sway anima, ix in wayichej jun tas te xiwub'tak.
Ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'ayin, ix in ib'xik'e yuj xiwelal.
Ay jun icha spixan anima ix wab' yek' masasok t'a in sat, ix k'e chijan xil in jolom yuj xiwelal.
Ix k'och linhan jun pixan chi' t'a in tz'ey ix wab'i. Maj wilochlaj. Haxo ix wab'ani ix sajsonk'ei, ix yalan icha tik:
¿Tokwal ay junok anima tojol t'a yichanh Dios? Wach'chom ay mach te tek'an, ¿tokwal malaj jab'ok spaltail t'a yichanh mach ix b'oani?
Ina max yak' wal och Dios heb' schekab' ay t'a satcha'anh yipok sk'ool. Inatax heb' ángel tz'och spaltail heb' t'a yichanh.
Okxom wal heb' anima. Jab'nhej sk'inal heb', lajan heb' icha junok xan pat b'ob'il t'a yib'anh lum pokok, k'un yem lanhnajok. Syal stek'chajem heb' icha nok' ij.
Wach'chom wach' heb' t'a q'uinhib'alil, haxo tz'emkan k'u, satxikanem heb'. Satel heb' t'a junelnhej, malaj mach skus yuj heb'.
Icha yik tz'em lanhnaj junok mantiado spolchaj sch'anhal, icha chi' yaj sk'inal heb' anima. Tz'ek'b'at lemnajok, malaj jab'ok jelanil syik'kan heb', xchi jun pixan chi' t'ayin.
Ha tiknaik ach Job elokab' aw, ol kila' mach junok ol tak'wok t'ayach. ¿Mach junok ángel ol ach kolanok?
Ha junok anima chuk spensar, schichon sk'ool, snib'anoch tastak. Ha schichonk'olal chi' ol ik'anel sk'inal.
Wilnak heb' chuk spensar, slaj k'echaanh tastak ay t'a heb', palta elanhchamel satxiem juntzanh chi'.
Ha yalyuninal heb', manhxa mach skolwaj t'a heb'. Ayik sk'och heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajal, manhxalaj tz'aj yelk'och heb', manhxa mach skolan heb'.
Ayik tz'elul sat yawb'en heb', haxo heb' anima wan scham yuj wejel slajaneli, sayanelta heb' t'a kaltak q'uiix. Haxo heb' malaj jab'ok tas ay t'ay, syiloch sk'ool heb' t'a sb'eyumal heb'.
Ha yaelal manh b'ajokto skoti, manhokto t'a yol lu'um sk'eta.
Toxonton yik yaelal kaji, icha te namix k'ak' tz'elnhejta t'a kal k'ak'.
Tato a in tik icha aj tik waji, elanhchamel am swak'och in b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Ha Dios satub'tak tastak sk'ulej, manhxo b'ischajb'enok tas k'ulej chi'. Malaj mach snachajel yuj tastak sk'ulej chi'.
Ha Dios chi' tz'ak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik. Icha chi' tz'aj yoch yalil masanil tas ay t'a sat lu'um.
Ha tz'ik'anchaanh heb' anima emnakil syutej sb'a, hanheja' pax tz'ak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' ayoch t'a syaelal.
Ha Dios chi' sjuanb'at tas nab'il yuj heb' jelan, yik max elk'ochi.
A' syamanoch waan heb' jelan t'a chukal, yik max elk'och tas snib'ej heb' t'a chukal chi'.
Ha wal t'a chimk'ualil stelwi heb', k'ik'k 'inal t'a heb'. Icha wal to t'ak'walil sb'eyek' heb', toxonhej tzek' machmon heb'.
Ha Dios skolan heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' chuk spensar, hanheja' skolan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ixtum anima.
A' ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' malaj stek'anil, ha' smakan sti' heb' manh tojolok syutej sb'a.
Wach' yik heb' skachji yuj Dios. Manh a patikejel a kachnab'il syak' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi'.
Tato ha Dios chi' tz'ak'an echnaj junok mach, ha' tz'anhtanpaxi. Tato ha' tz'ak'anoch syaelal junok mach, a tz'ak'anpax b'oxok sk'ool.
Tzijtum el ol ach kolchaj yuj Dios t'a tas ay smay. Manh ol ach scha ak'jok ganar yuj junok tas sjawi t'a ib'anh.
T'a stiempoal wejel ol ach kolchaj yuj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Ayik ay owal, hanheja' ol ach kolanpaxok.
Ha Dios ol ach kolan t'a tas syal heb' alum pekal. Manh ol ach xiwok ayik sjawi yalnhej tas t'a ib'anh.
Ayik ol jawok wejel, ma owal, tonhej ol ach tzewajok. Manh ol ach xiwok ayik ol jawok nok' chium nok'.
Ha b'aj ol ach munlajok, malaj k'een k'een ol ach ixtanok. Ha nok' chium nok', malaj tas ol ach yutej nok'.
Ol ajxok jantak tastak t'a a pat. Ayik ol a b'isan nok' a molb'etzal nok' tz'akannhej yajek' nok'.
Tzijtum ol aj sb'isul inhtilal icha anh ank'ultak sq'uib' t'a sat lum lum.
Icham winak hachxo ol ach chamok, icha junok tob'anh ixim trigo k'anxo sjochchaji.
Ach Job, a tas kojtak a tzonh k'ayb'ani. Kojtak to icha chi' yaji, yuj chi' scham wal a b'eyk'olan juntzanh tik, xchi winhaj Elifaz chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Tato smasanil in yaelal yet' in kusk'olal tik, tz'echtaj t'a yol junok echlab',
tekan ek'to yalil t'a yichanh yarenail sti' ha' mar, yuj chi' ix in komon alej icha tik.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ichato ix och ch'apnaj sjul-lab' t'ayin, haxo svenenoal spukax t'a in niwanil. Toxo ix oymaj tas ay smay t'ayin yuj.
¿Tokwal tz'ok' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru tato ay yanh nok'? ¿Tokwal tz'ok' nok' mam wakax tato ay tas sk'ux nok'?
¿Mach schi'an junok chib'il wail tato malaj yatz'amil? ¿Tokwal wach' sloji sakil nok' nholob' tato malaj yatz'amil?
Icha chib'il wail malaj yatz'amil, icha chi' tas tzin chi tiknaik swab'i. Manhxalaj in gana in wa'i.
Komonok tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios yak'an tas tzin k'an t'ay. Komonok syak' tas tzin nib'ej.
Komonok tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios chi' in sataneli, yik tzin lajwiel t'a junelnhej.
Wach'chom swab' syail yuj in yaelal yet' in kusk'olal tik, palta tzin te tzalaji, yujto swak'nhej och sley Dios yipok in k'ool, haton Dios Haxonhej Ochi.
Manhxalaj wip swab'i yik swak'an techaj in yaelal tik, ¿tasxom yuj komon pitzan hinto?
¿Tokwal lajan stzatzil in niwanil tik icha k'een k'een? ¿Tokwal icha stzatzil k'een bronce stzatzil in b'ak'chil?
Maxtzak yal in kolan in b'a t'a yol wiko'. Manhxa junok mach skolwaj wet'ok.
Ha junok mach ayoch t'a syaelal, wach'chom manhxa yelk'och Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'ay, palta smoj wal tz'ak'ji sniwanil sk'ol yuj heb' swach'k'ool.
Palta a ex tik ex wamigo, tonhej ix in he wach' juejeli. Lajan ex icha junok ha' eluma' stup t'a smelemal.
Ayik syak'an nhab' tat tz'aj sat ha' sb'eyi kalan ha' yet' k'een cheew, ma yet' k'een sakb'akom.
Ayik tz'ulax k'een cheew chi', stupem ha' eluma' chi', haxo yik tzowaj k'ak' stakjiem ha'.
Ha heb' anima b'eyum, sb'at heb' t'a titak b'e yik sayan ha' heb' yuk'ej, haxo tz'aji, satkanb'at heb' t'a lum takinh lu'um chi', hata' schamkan heb'.
Ha heb' b'eyum anima aj chonhab' Temán yet' heb' aj Sabá, say ha ha' heb' yojtaktaxon b'aj skani,
haxo yik sk'och heb' b'aj aytaxon ha' chi', takinhxo yet'tal ha', toxonhej stakkank'e sk'ol heb'.
Icha chi' heyaj t'ayin a ex tik, yujto ayik tzeyilanoch jantak in yaelal tik, tonhej tzex xiwk'ei.
Palta a in tik, malaj tas tzin k'an t'ayex. Malaj tumin tzin k'an t'ayex yik tzin kolchaji.
¿Tokwal tzin k'an he kolwal yik tzin kolchaj t'a yol sk'ab' jun ajk'ol t'ayin, ma t'a juntzanh heb' elk'um?
Hak'ek in k'ayb'ub'al, ol in cha wab' t'ayex. Ch'oxek och in mul chi' t'a in sat.
Malaj junok mach spatikanel junok pensar to wach', palta a ex tik, manhxa stzolal tas tzeyak'och t'a wib'anh.
Ha ex tik nab'anhej tzin he tumej, palta eyojtak to a slolonel junok mach ayoch t'a syaelal, ay b'aj malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi.
Ha ex tik, syal eyak'an he suerte t'a yib'anh heb' meb'a' ob'iltak. Syalpax he chonhanel junok eyamigo.
Ochanhek k'elan t'a in sat, tato tonhej swesej.
Aktejek eyalan juntzanh chi' t'a in patik. Komonok tzeyojtakejeli to yel juntzanh swal tik.
Ha he naani to esalwum in. Ha he naani to manh wojtakok tas yel yet' tas manh yelok.
Ha onh anima kajan onh t'a sat lum tik, lajan wal kab'an syail icha junok soldado ma icha junok chekab' yaji.
Ha junok chekab', snib'ej elanhchamel sq'uik'b'i. Ha junok munlajwum, snib'ej elanhchamel scha stojol.
Icha chi' waj yet' in yaelal tik, ujal swab' syail. Junjun ak'wal aynhejoch in kusk'olal.
Ayik tzin ek' jichan, te najat yek' ak'wal swab'i. Tzin tzaktzaj wek' b'alb'onok, max sakb'ilaj. Swalan icha tik: ¿Janik' ol in k'e waan? xin chi.
Majnakel in niwanil tik yuj nok' ha'ay. Takinh kechinak sat, slaj k'e tzililjok tz'elxi spojowal.
Ha in k 'inal elanhchamel tz'eq'ui, icha yek' sjul-lab' heb' ch'alwum sjulek' t'a skal sch'al. Wan sk'och in k 'inal tik t'a slajwub', manhxa tas ayoch yipok in k'ool.
Ach in Diosal, nakoti, a jab' in k 'inal tik, lajan icha yik skik'an junelok kik'. Manhxa b'ak'uinh tzalajk'olal ol in ajok.
Ha heb' anima tzin ilan tiknaik, manhxo ol in yil-laj heb'. Ol in satelok, manhxo ol in ilpaxlaj.
Icha yek' numumok asun satxikanemi, icha chi' tz'aj satxiem junok anima ayik sb'at mukchajkan t'a kampusante. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol jaxok, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol yiloch heb' sk'ab'yok.
Yuj chi' max yal wem numan, yuj in yaelal yet' in kusk'olal tik, ol walnhej tas swala'.
Mamin ¿tom lajan in icha nok' niwan nok' t'a yol ha' mar tzila', yuj chi' aynhejoch a sat t'ayin?
Ayik tzin naani, tekan wach' ol in way jab'ok t'a in ch'at, tope tz'och waan jab'ok in yaelal tik yik tzin way jab'ok, xin chi.
Haxo juntzanh wayich xiwub'tak tzak' wila'', tzin a te xib'tani.
Más wach' tzin a b'inchamok, más wach' tzin cham t'a yichanh to pitzan in.
Maxtzak techaj wuj swab'i, nab'axonhej pitzan in. Manhxo in ixtej. Ha in k 'inal tik lajan icha yik skik'an junelok kik'.
¿Tas kelk'och a onh anima onh tik, yuj chi' tzonh ik'chaanh? ¿Tas yuj tzach och ilk'olal kuuj?
¿Tas yuj aynhejoch a chum t'ayonh t'a junjun k'u, tzonh ak'annhej prowal?
¿Tas yuj max ik'el jab'ok a sat t'ayin, yik syal in b'uk'anem jab'ok yal in ti'?
Ach Dios, Yilumal anima aji. Tato tz'och in mul, ¿tom tzab' syail yuj? ¿Tas yuj a t'ayin tzak'och ijan a jul-lab'? ¿Tom al wajoch t'ayach icha junok ikatz?
¿Tom maxtzak ak' niwank'olal in mul? ¿Tom maxtzak ak' niwank'olal tastak chukal ix in k'ulej? Toxo wal tzin b'atkan t'a yol lu'um. Ol in a sayeq'ui, manhxo ol in chax uuj, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Bildad aj Súa icha tik:
¿B'aq'uinh ol aktej a lolon icha tik? Lajan a lolonel tik icha junok owal chakxuxum ik'.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, malaj b'ak'uinh syixtejb'at tojolal, max yik'ek' smakb'en junok anima.
Tekan ix och smul heb' uninal chi' t'a Dios, yuj chi' ix ak'ji syaelal heb' yuj t'a smojalil.
Ak' wal och a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, tza k'anan t'ay to tz'ok' sk'ol t'ayach.
Tato wach' a pensar, tojolnhej tzutej a b'a. Ol ach skol Dios chi', ol yak'anxi masanil tastak iktaxon yaji.
Ha a b'eyumal t'a yalanhtaxo, manhxo ol yal slajb'an sb'a yet' jantak tas ol ajxok t'ayach.
k'anb'ejek' ab'i tas ek'nak heb' anima t'a peka', tza k'ayb'an sjelanil heb' chi'.
Ha onh tik ichato ewi onh alji, malaj jab'ok tas kojtak. Ha ko k 'inal t'a sat lum tik lajan icha yek' junok enhul.
Ha heb' anima t'a peka', jantak tas b'aj syal ach sk'ayb'ankan heb'.
Ha te' junco yet' te' papiro, anhej b'aj ay ha ha' sq'uib' te'.
Te yaax te', palta tato stup ha', b'ab'el stakjixiel te' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo te te'.
Icha wal chi' ol aj heb' sk'ulan chukal, haton heb' sb'atkan Dios satk'olal yuj, maxtzak elk'och tas ayoch yipok sk'ol heb'.
Ha tas komon ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' chi', lajan wal icha ch'alxim.
Q'uinalok ay mach tz'och yub'naj t'a ch'alxim chi', malaj jab'ok yip. Q'uinalok tzonh kan t'unhnaj t'ay, max techajlaj yuj.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, lajan wal heb' icha sat anh ank'ultak tz'el tziknaj yuj yok k'u, spukaxkanb'at t'a skaltak awb'en,
sb'atkan t'a slot'iltak k'een k'een, slaj q'uib' anh, sb'at anh t'a yib'anhtak k'een.
Palta tato ay mach stok'ank'eta anh, manhxa mach ojtannak tato ek'nak anh ta'.
Icha chi' tz'aj slajwiel anh, ch'okxo junokxo ank'ultak sq'uib' b'aj tok'b'ilk'eta anh chi'.
Ha Dios, max aktajkan junok mach wach' spensar yuj. Max kolwajlaj t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Tato tza na a b'a, ha' ol ach ak'anxi tzewajok, ol yak'anxi a tzalajk'olal.
Haxo pax heb' ajk'ool, ol q'uixwokkan heb'. Ha spat heb' chuk spensar chi', ol lajwokelok, xchi winhaj Bildad chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Wojtak wal sik'lab'il to icha chi' yaji. Palta, ¿tok ay junok onh syal kalanoch ko b'a wach'il t'a yichanh Dios?
Q'uinalok sko telaj ko b'a yet'ok, malaj am junok tas syal ko pakan t'ay t'a milok tas sk'anb'ej t'ayonh.
Ha Dios te niwan sjelanil yet' spoder. Q'uinalok sko tek'b'ej ko b'a t'a yichanh, ¿tokwal stechaj kuuj?
Ha yuj yowal sk'ol Dios tz'ib'xik'e lum niwak witz, tz'el lum k'akap, malaj mach ojtannak tato tzuji juntzanh chi'.
Ayik stzikub'tanhan lum lum tik t'a yet'tal, tz'ib'xi sb'akhnub'al lu'um.
Ha Dios chi' syal yalan t'a k'u to max jawilaj, syalanpax t'a k'een k'anal to max yak'laj yok k'een.
Malaj junok mach ix kolwaj yet'ok ayik ix yak'anb'at jenhan satcha'anh. Hanheja' pax stek'anem sat ha' mar yik sk'e chulnaj ha'.
A' ixb'o'an juntzanh k'een k'anal skuch niwan Osa, k'een Oxt'ilanh, k'een Mootz yet' juntzanhxo k'een yaman yaji scheklaj t'a stojolal sur.
Manhxo b'ischajb'enok tastak satub'tak sk'ulej. Ha juntzanh chi' malaj junok mach syal snachajel yuj.
Tato tzek' Dios t'a ko tz'ey, max yal-laj kilani. Tato tzek' t'a chi' ¿tok snachajel wuuj?
Tato ay tas syik'ek' t'a junok mach, ¿mach syal skachanoch waan? ¿mach syal sk'anb'an t'ay tas sk'ulej?
Tato skot yowal sk'ol Dios chi', max yal yoch waan t'a ichnhej ta'. Ha heb' ayoch yet' Rahab ol kan heb' t'a yalanh yuj.
Yuj chi', ¿tas lolonel syal walani yik tzin pakan t'a Dios?
Wach'chom malaj in mul, palta max yal-laj in tak'wi t'ay. In juezal yaji, tzin k'anan yok'elk'olal t'ayin.
Q'uinalok swawtej Dios chi' b'aj tzin ch'olb'itaji, wach'chom sk'ochi, palta ¿tokwal ol scha yab' tas swala'?
Haxo tz'aji, tzam in yak' lajwok yet' junok ik'nhab' te ow, swach' niwtaj in yaelal tik t'a ichnhej ta'.
Maxtzak xom yal wik'an wip junok rato. Tzam te wach' niwtaj in yaelal tik yuj.
Q'uinalok swak' pural Dios chi' yik sb'oan icha tzin nib'ej, max yal-laj yujto haton Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Q'uinalok swawtej t'a yichanh heb' juez, ¿mach syal yak'an pural sk'ochi?
Q'uinalok swala' te wach' in, haxo in lolonel sch'oxaneli to ay in paltail. Q'uinalok swala' to malaj jab'ok in paltail chi', axom Dios tz'alani to manh yelok.
Wach'chom a in tik malaj in mul, palta malaj welk'och t'a yol in sat, maxtzak yal in k'ol pitzan in.
Ha in naani, lajanxonhej smasanil. Ha Dios chi' satanel heb' ay smul yet' heb' malaj smul.
Q'uinalok sjawi chamel t'a yib'anh masanil anima, malaj tas sna Dios chi' ayik slajwiel anima malaj smul.
Skan jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk yuj, smakchaj sat heb' juez yuj. Tato manhok Dios sk'ulani, ¿mach sk'ulan jun?
Elanhchamel tzek'b'at in k 'inal, malaj jab'ok tzalajk'olal swila'.
Lajan wal sb'ey in k 'inal tik icha sb'ey junok te' balso t'a sat ha ha', haton te' b'ob'il yet' te' papiro. Lajan pax icha sb'at xumumok nok' ch'akb'a yik syaman schib'ej nok'.
Q'uinalok sb'atkan in yaelal tik satk'olal wuuj, tzalajk'olal am tzin ajkani.
Palta masanil in yaelal tik tonhej tzin somchajel yuj, yujto wojtak to max in yal Dios wach'il.
Tato ay in mul yalani, nab'anhej swak' wip walani to wach' in.
Wach'chom tzin b'ik in k'ab' yet' nok' xapon, ma yet' yal taanh,
palta ha Dios tzin yak'nhejem t'a skal ha ha' sok'omtak, haxo in pichul sq'uixwi wuuj.
Max yal in pakan in b'a t'a Dios icha t'a junok komon anima. Max yal walani to syal in b'at yet'ok t'a yichanh heb' juez.
Komonok ay junok mach syal yak'an wil-laj in b'a yet'ok, syalan tas tzonh aj ko chawanhil.
Oktom ay junok mach syal yalan t'ay yik tz'och waan yak'anoch in yaelal, tz'och waan in xib'tani.
Tato icha chi', maxtzak am in xiw in loloni, yujto malaj in mul icha eyalan tik.
Manhxa in gana pitzan in. Ol wak' cheklaj in yaelal tik, ol in lolon yet' in k'ak'alk'olal.
Swal t'a Dios, manh tonhejok tzak'och in mul t'a wib'anh, al t'ayin b'aj ix och in mul chi'.
Ina a ach in a b'onak, ¿tom wach' tzab'i tzin a chakkaneli? Chuk tz'alji t'ayin, haxo yet' tas sna heb' chuk spensar tzach ochi.
¿Tom lajan ilan icha kilan a onh anima onh tik?
¿Tom lajan a k 'inal icha jab' kik a onh chamelb'a anima onh tik?
Yuj chi' ¿tas yuj tza say walek' in mul yet' in paltail?
Wach'chom ojtak to malaj in mul, malaj junok mach syal in skolanel t'a yol a k'ab'.
Ha ach wal ix in a b'o'o, haxo tiknaik tza nib'ej tzin a sateli.
Nakoti to t'a lum lum ix in a b'o'o, haxo tiknaik, tzin ak'anxikanoch pokokal.
Ix a b'o in niwanil tik icha tz'aj sb'o nok' queso ayik spajb'i nok' lech.
Ha ach ix ak' syamlaj sb'a in b'akil yet' in ch'anhal. Ix ak'anoch in b'ak'chil yet' in tz'umal t'a spatik.
Ix ak' in k 'inal, ix in a xajanani. Ix in a tanhwej, yuj chi' pitzan in.
Palta haxo tiknaik jun, snachajel wuuj to ay tas k'ub'eltak tza na' t'a in patik.
Wan in hilani tato tz'och in mul, max in ak' niwank'olal jab'ok yuj in mul chi'.
Tato ay in mul, ob'iltak in. Tato malaj in mul, palta max yal woch t'a ichanh t'a junk'olal, yujto tzin q'uixwi, tzin naankot in yaelal.
Tato swik'chaanh in b'a, satub'tak am tzutej in a sataneli. Icham syutej nok' choj spechan junok nok' yik schi'a, icha chi' am tzin utej.
Tza say juntzanh testigo t'a in patik. Tzak' wal kot owal t'ayin, icha skot nhilnaj heb' soldado yak'an owal.
¿Tas yuj in a chanak aljok? Komonok ayik manto in aljok ix in chamkani, yik malaj mach iljinak in.
Komonok ayik waljinak t'a in nun, wik'chajnakb'at t'a kampusante, ichato malaj mach cheklajnak.
Yakb'an to jab'nhej in k 'inal tik, elok t'a a k'ol tzak'an jab'ok in junk'olal. Elok t'a a k'ol tzak'an jab'ok in tzalajk'olal,
yik manto in b'at t'a chamub' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal b'aj maxtzak yal in paxta. Ha t'a jun lugar chi', wewentak yilji, k'ik' k'inal xonhej, manhxalaj jab'ok sakil k'inal, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Zofar aj Naamat t'a winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ha juntzanh a komon lolonel tik smoj wal spakji t'ayach. Manh yujok to tzach te loloni, scheklaji to wach' ach.
Ha a naani yujto tzach te loloni manhxa tas skala'. Ha a naani to manhxalaj mach syal spakan juntzanh a b'uchwal lolonel tik.
Ha ach tik tzala' to wach' ach t'a yichanh Dios, tzaloch a b'a wach'il.
Komonok slolon Dios spakan juntzanh tzal chi',
sch'oxan sjelanil t'ayach k'ub'eltak yaji, haton juntzanh max yal snachajeli. Ichato chi' ol hilani to mantzak yak' a yaelal Dios icha wal smoj a chaani.
¿Am a naani to ol ojtakej wal el sjelanil Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, haton juntzanh k'ub'eltak yaji?
¿Tas wal ol aj ojtakanel jun jelanil chi'? Yujto ek'b'al te chaanh yajk'e icha yajk'e satcha'anh tik. Te ek'b'al jul yajem t'a yichanh b'aj ay heb' chamnak.
Te ek'b'al t'a yichanh lum lum tik. Te lewan sat t'a yichanh ha' mar.
Tato ha Dios tzach awtani yik tzach sch'olb'itej, ¿mach junok syal skachanoch waan?
Yojtak heb' esalwum, hanheja' syil jantak chukal, ¿mato tza na' to manh yojtakok Dios chi'?
¿Tokwal syal yalji junok nok' b'uru icha spensar junok anima? Icha chi' junok mach malaj spensar, ¿tokwal ol yal sjawi spensar?
Tato tza tojolb'itej a pensar, al a yaelal t'a Dios.
Aktejkan a k'ulan chukal yet' juntzanh tas tza k'ulej t'a elk'altak.
Tato icha chi', wach' ilji t'a sat Dios, manhxalaj b'aj ol ach q'uixwok. Tzalajk'olal ol ach ajok, manhxa b'aj ol ach xiwok,
haxo sat a k'ol t'a a yaelal ix ek' tik. Icha tz'aj stup ha ha' sb'eyi, icha chi' ol aj sat t'a a k'ool.
Wach'chom ix ach kan t'a k'ik' k'inal yuj a yaelal tik, palta haxo tiknaik ichato ol sakb'okpaxel t'a ib'anh icha t'a q'uinhib'alil. Tzalajk'olal ol ach ajxok, ichato chimk'ualil b'aj ayach eq'ui.
Junk'olal ol ach ajxok, yujto ay tas ayoch yipok a k'ool. Ha Dios ol ach tanhwanok, junk'olal ol ach wayok.
Ol ik' ip, malaj tas ol ach xib'tanok. Tzijtum mach ol jawok ach sayeq'ui, wach' ol ach aj yet' heb'.
Haxo heb' chuk spensar, olto skomon sayej heb' b'aj skolchaji, palta nab'axonhej. Manhxo ol ilchaj b'aj syal skolan sb'a heb', haxonhej chamel ol yak'och heb' yipok sk'ool, xchi winhaj Zofar chi'.
Ix spakanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ha wal swab'ani to a exxonhej eyojtak masanil tas t'a skal masanil anima. Ayik ol ex chamok, tekan ol satkanel jelanil.
Palta a in pax tik ay pax in pensar, mato yelxo wal malaj jab'ok tas wojtak t'a eyichanh he naani, ¿mach wal junok manh ojtannakok juntzanh tik?
Wach'chom a in tik malaj in mul, ma in paltail, wach'chom ix yab' Dios in tewi t'a yalanhtaxo, haxo tiknaik toxonhej tzin tzetzaji.
Ha ex malaj jab'ok tas tzex ik'an tik, tzex te b'uchwaj t'ayin. Lajan ex icha junok mach swach' ekan telwok junok mach wanxo stelwi.
Ha heb' elk'um, tzalajk'olal yaj heb' t'a yol spat. Ha heb' tz'alan chuk t'a Dios, junk'olal yaj heb'. Ha snaan heb' to malaj tas ol utaj heb' yuj.
k'anb'ejek t'a nok' nok' t'a sat lu'um yet' t'a nok' sjenhwi, syal ex sk'ayb'an nok'.
k'anb'ejekpax t'a nok' tzek' nhernhon t'a sat lu'um yet' nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar, syal ex sk'ayb'an nok' t'a jelanil.
Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi', yojtak nok' to a tas tzuji a Jehová tz'ak'ankoti.
Ha t'a yol sk'ab' ay sk'inal masanil tastak pitzan, syak'an yik' yik' heb' anima.
Ha yol ko ti' tz'ab'lan swach'il tas skab'lej. Ha pax ko chikin tz'ab'an tas tz'alchaji.
Ha heb' ichamtak winak, ayxo spensar heb', yujto tzijtumxo ab'il syil heb', yuj chi' ay spensar heb'.
Palta ha Dios toxonton jelan, syal yuj smasanil.
Ha tas satel Dios, manhxa junok mach syal sb'oanxi. Ha junok mach syamchajoch waan yuj Dios, manhxa junok mach skolani.
Tato ha' syamanoch waan nhab', stakjiel masanil tastak t'a sat lu'um tik. Tato syak'paxkot nhab', sb'at ha' t'a yalanh lu'um.
Ha Dios ay spoder, jelan toni, tz'elnhejk'och yuj. A' t'a yol sk'ab' ayek' heb' smusan sat heb' anima yet' pax heb' tz'ak'ji musansatil chi'.
A' tz'ak'an satel spensar heb' jelan. Haxo heb' juez somchajkank'e spensar heb' yuj.
A' tz'ik'anel heb' rey t'a yopisio, syak'an ik'jokb'at heb' t'a preso t'a junokxo ch'ok chonhab'il, b'eranel heb' sb'atkan heb'.
A' tz'ak'an kistalax heb' sacerdote. A' tz'ak'an ak'jok ganar heb' niwak yopisio.
Ha heb' ak'um razón yipk'olal yaji, manhxalaj tas syal yalan heb'. Ha heb' ayoch yopisio sch'olb'itan heb' anima, tz'ik'jiek' sjelanil heb' yuj.
A' tz'ak'an patikajkanel heb' niwak yelk'och t'a heb' anima. Haxo heb' te tek'an, tz'elkan yip heb' yuj.
Syak'an ojtakajel tas k'ub'eltak yaji. Syak'an cheklaj tas manh ojtakab'ilok.
Ha Dios chi' tz'ik'anchaanh juntzanh niwak chonhab', hanheja' satanpaxeli. Ha saklemanb'at heb' anima, hanheja' smolb'anxi heb'.
Ha tz'ik'anek' sjelanil heb' yajalil junok chonhab', yuj chi' ichato satkanb'at heb' t'a tzinan lum b'aj manhxalaj b'e.
Toxonhej machmon yek' heb' icha t'a k'ik' k'inal. Toxonhej sketkonek' heb' icha heb' uk'um anh.
Masanil juntzanh tik ix wil wal yet' in sat, ix wab' wal yet' in chikin.
Ha tas eyojtak a ex tik, wojtakpaxi, mantok yelxo wal emnakil waj t'ayex.
Palta tzin nib'ej tzin lolon yet' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Tzin nib'ej tzin telaj in b'a yet'ok.
Ha ex tik, yuj eyesalwumal tze k'ub'anel tas yel. Lajan ex yet' heb' anhtum malaj wach' yochi.
Komonok numan tzex aji, yik icha chi' scheklaji to jelan ex.
Maklejek eyab' tas ol wala', ol wal tas nab'il wuuj.
¿Am he naani to ol ex kolwaj t'a Dios yuj eyesalwumal chi'? ¿Am he naani to ay tas ol yik' t'a he ak'oj musansatil chi'?
Tze nib'ej tzeyak'och he b'a yet' Dios, tze kolan he naani.
Palta q'uinalok tzex ch'olb'itaj yuj Dios chi', ¿tas tzex aj he naani? ¿Tzam yal eyak'an musansatil, icha tzeyutej junok anima?
Tato tze komon ak'ejoch he b'a yet' Dios he naani, ol ex stumej sik'lab'il.
Ha wal smay ol ik'an he xiwi, mato syal he tek'b'an he b'a t'a yichanh he naani.
Ha juntzanh peka' k'ayb'ub'al tzeyala', malaj yelk'ochi, lajan icha junok muro nab'a lu'um skak'och yipok ko k'ool.
Haxo tiknaik, tz'inek xe chi to ol in lolonok, taxonhej skot t'a wib'anh yuj tas ol wal tik.
Wach'chom skotxonhej t'a wib'anh, palta ol walnhej.
Wach'chom yuj chi' tzin smilcham Dios, palta ol wak'nhejoch yipok in k'ool. Ol in kolnhej in b'a t'a yichanh.
Talaj hata' ay in kolnab'il, yujto a junok mach chuk max stek'b'ej sb'a yoch t'a yichanh Dios.
Maklejek wal eyab' tas ol aj walani.
Toxo ix in na' tas ol wutej in kolan in b'a, wojtak to wach' ol in elk'ochok.
Tato ay mach sch'oxaneli to ay in mul, syal woch waan walani masanto tzin chami.
Ach in Diosal, chab'nhej wal tas tzin k'an t'ayach, icha chi' syal in k'och t'a ichanh.
Aktejxo ak'anoch in yaelal tik, manhxo in a xib'tej yet' tas ay smay.
Awtej in, ol in tak'wok t'ayach, ma jun, tzin b'ab'laj loloni, tzach tak'wi t'ayin.
Al t'ayin, ¿b'ajtil ix och in mul, ma in paltail? ¿B'ajtil ay b'aj ix in ek' t'a yib'anh chi'?
¿Tas yuj tza k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayin? ¿Tas yuj icha junok ajk'ol tzin utej?
Lajan in icha junok xil te' tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik', ma icha anh takinh ak. ¿Tas yuj tzak' owal wet'ok, tza nib'ej tzin a sateli?
Te ya tzal t'ayin swab'i. Tza k'anb'an t'ayin tastak in mul yiktax in kelemal.
Ichato ix ak'och k'een cadena t'a wok, k'elan achnhej ochi b'aj tz'em wok.
Yuj chi' wanxo in k'ab'at icha junok tas sk'ai, ma icha junok pichul ijtakxo.
Ha onh anima onh tik tzonh alji t'a ko nun, jab'nhej tiempo skila', skalnhej yaelal tzonh eq'ui.
Lajan ko k 'inal tik icha junok anh xumak wanto spojeli, elanhchamel stakjipaxi. Lajan pax icha tz'aj satxikanem junok enhul.
Mamin, ¿tas yuj tzak' wal och a sat t'ayin to anima innhej? ¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tza ch'olb'itej junok tas malaj yelk'ochi?
¿Tok ay mach syal yik'anel tas wach' t'a skal tas manh wach'ok?
Ha ach tik tzala' jantak tiempo syil junjun anima. Chekel yaji jaye' sb'isul k'ual skila', max yal yek' jayeokxo k'ual uuj.
Ik'el a sat t'ayin yik tzin kan t'a junk'olal. Ak' tzalajb'ok in k'ol icha stzalajb'i sk'ol heb' munlajwum, ayik slajwi smunlaj heb'.
Ayik sch'akjiel junok te te', skak'och yipok ko k'ool to ol ja swol te', haxo te swol chi' sq'uib'xi.
Wach'chom te ichamxo te' sch'anhal yib' chi', wach'chom wanxo sk'ab'at te' yib',
haxo yik tz'emk'och sikal ha ha' t'a te', syaxb'ixi te', swolanxi te' icha junok te' yuneto tz'awchaji.
Ha onhxo pax anima onh tik, ayik tzonh chami, manhxa tas syal kuuj. Ayik tz'el ko pixan, manhxalaj mach tzonh hilani.
Icha tz'aj sk'e waan xob'al ha' mar, ma icha tz'aj stup ha ha' sb'eyi,
icha chi' tz'aj ko cham a onh anima onh tik. Yakb'an aytoek' satcha'anh tik, malaj wal junok chamnak anima ol komon pitzwok b'aj mukan, malaj junok ol komon k'e waan t'a yet'tal chi'.
Komonok tzin a k'ub'ejel t'a chamel chi', yakb'an tzek'b'at yowal a k'ool. Tza naanpaxi b'ak'uinh tzin a naxikoti.
Ha junok anima schami, ¿tom ol pitzwokxi? Palta a inxo tik ol wak' techaj in yaelal tik, masanto ol k'och sk'ual wel t'a libre.
Ol ach awaj t'ayin, ol in tak'wok t'ayach. Ol am ach tzalaj in ilanochi, yujto a ach a b'onak in.
Ha tiknaik, k'elan ach och t'a in b'eyb'al. Haxo t'a jun k'ual chi', manhxo ol ik' a cuenta t'a in mul.
Ol b'atkan in chukal chi' satk'olal uuj. Ol ak'an lajwok in mul.
Ha lum niwak witz ayik tz'elta lum k'akapil, satem lu'um, haxo k'een niwak k'een tz'el k'een t'a yet'tal.
Hanhejtona' icha tz'aj yulaxb'at k'een k'een t'a yol sb'e ha ha', ma icha tz'aj yik'chajb'at lum lum yuj ha', icha chi' tz'aj ak'an lajwok tas ayoch yipok ko k'ool a onh anima onh tik.
Ha ach te ek'b'al achnhej t'a kichanh, tzonh ik'anxi meltzaj t'a junelnhej, tzak'an ixtax ko sat yik tzonh chami.
Wach'chom a heb' kalkuninal te b'inajnak ol aj heb', mato ay heb' manhxalaj ol aj yelk'ochi, palta manhxo kojtakok, manhxalaj mach ol yal yalan kab'i.
Q'uinalok chamnak onhxo, haxonhej am kuuj skak' pensar, yujto skab'wal syail, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Elifaz aj Temán icha tik:
Ha mach jelan, manh smojok stak'wi t'a komon lolonel, manh smojok pax syik'chaanh sb'a syalan tas tonhej sb'at yuj ik'.
Manh tonhejok skomon loloni, max sk'anlaj komon pensar.
Ach Job, tzala' to malaj yelk'och xiwk'olal t'a Dios, malaj pax yelk'och ejmelal t'ayach.
Ha yuj tas tzala' a sch'oxanel a mul. Tza nib'ej tza musej ko sat yet' sjelanilal a pensar chi'.
Manh a na' to a in ol walk'eta a mul, a yuj tas tzala' tzik'kot t'a ib'anh.
¿Tom a a naani to a ach b'ab'el b'ob'il ach? ¿Tom ayachxo ayik ix laj b'oji lum niwak witz?
¿Tom tz'eyanoch a chikin ayik ix snaan Dios tas ol sk'ulej? ¿Tokwal a achnhej jelan ach t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik?
Masanil tas ojtak, kojtak pax a onh tik.
Ha ko jelanil, ix ko k'ayb'ej t'a heb' ichamtak winak sakxo xil sjolom, haton heb' ichamtak winak t'a yichanh winh a mam.
Ha Dios snib'ej syak' sniwanil a k'ol yet' lolonel k'ununi skal t'ayach, ¿tas yuj max a cha ab'i?
¿Tas yuj tzik'el a b'a t'a Dios, tz'elwalkot jinhjinh yol a sat skot owal?
¿Tas yuj skot wal owal t'a Dios, komonxonhej tzal juntzanh lolonel?
¿Tok ay junok anima wach'nhej to malaj jab'ok smul?
Inatax heb' ángel, manh ayokoch heb' yipok sk'ol Dios yet' pax satcha'anh, manh wal yelxo wach'ok t'a yol sat.
Okxo wal a onh anima onh tik yajb'entak onh. Icha ko komon uk'an ha ha', icha chi' ko k'ulan chukal chi'.
Ach Job, komonok tza maklej ab' tas ol wala'. Ha jab'ok tas wojtak, ha' ol wala'.
Ha heb' aj pensar, a heb' ix onh k'ayb'ani. Ha tas yojtak heb' chi' sk'ayb'ejnakkan heb' t'a heb' smam yicham.
Haton t'a heb' smam yicham heb' chi' ak'b'il lum lum tik, manh skalejnakok sb'a heb' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha heb' anima chuk sb'eyb'al, tzapan sk'inal heb', skalnhej yaelal tzek' heb'.
Ayik syab'an heb' sk'anh junok tas, xiwk'e heb'. Haxo yik malaj tas sna heb', sjawi heb' elk'um, syelk'anb'at heb' tas ay t'a heb'.
Manhxa tas ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' yik skolchaj heb' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Ayxo och ijan k'een kuchilub' t'a heb' yik scham heb'.
Haxo sniwanil heb' ol chijokb'at yuj nok' ostok. Yojtak heb' to a tas ol kot t'a yib'anh heb', manh ol ek'laj.
Ha yaelal yet' ilk'olal ol ak'an xiwk'e heb', icha tz'aj ko xiwk'e t'a yichanh junok yajal sjawi yak' owal t'ayonh.
Icha chi' tz'aj sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' syik'chaanh sb'a t'a yichanh Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh.
Ichato yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb', sb'at lemnaj heb' yak' owal yet' Dios.
Te b'ak'uech sat heb' yet' sniwanil,
yujto yak'nak ganar juntzanh chonhab' heb', yikannakkan juntzanh pat heb' manhxalaj yajal, palta ol lajwokel juntzanh chonhab' chi' yet' juntzanh pat chi' yuj owal.
Manh najtilok ol ek' heb' yet' sb'eyumal. Ol satel heb' icha yek' swewenal asun.
Manhxo ol yal skolanel sb'a heb' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Lajan ol aj heb' icha junok te' k'ab' te' stz'a yuj k'ak', ma icha junok te te' tz'el xumakil yuj ik'.
Mokab' yak'och tas chuklaj heb' yipok sk'ool, yujto a spak ol scha heb' haton yaelal.
Ol pet cham heb', icha junok te' k'ab'te' stzepjiel t'a snunal maxtzak yaxb'i.
Lajan ol aj heb' icha junok ib' te' uwa tz'el b'ulnaj sat ayik manto q'uinhb'i, ma icha junok te' olivo tonhej sk'ajb'anel xumakil.
Ha heb' chuk chi', malaj yinhtilal heb' ol elkanok. Ha jantak sb'eyumal heb' ix yik' t'a elk'altak, tonhej ol tz'akanb'atok.
Haton heb' anhej chukal nab'il yuj, anhej ixtoj anima naan yuj heb', xchi winhaj Elifaz chi'.
Ix tak'wixi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ayxo skajwi in te ab'an juntzanh lolonel tzeyalub'tanhej tik. Tzeyak'och he b'a eyak'an sniwanil in k'ool, palta anhej yaelal tze wach' ik'ejkot t'a wib'anh.
¿Tom malaj slajwub' juntzanh he lolonel malaj yelk'och tik? ¿Tas eyaji yuj chi' anhej wal ha' he pakan t'ayin?
Q'uinalok a ex tik icha wal waj tik eyaji, max am wal-laj icha tzeyutej eyalan tik t'ayin, max am in tzikub'tanhej in sat walan jantak lolonel t'ayex.
Palta jun, a am lolonel wach' syak' sniwanil he k'ool, syak' he tek'anil, a am swal t'ayex.
Manh yujok to tzin loloni, tz'och waan in yaelal tik, manh yujok pax to tzin em numan tz'ochpax waan.
Ha Dios tz'ak'an lajwokel wip. Ha pax tz'ik'anel heb' wamigo t'ayin.
Ichato preso waj yuj. Jantak tas syik'chaanh heb' anima t'a in patik, jantak es lolonel syik'kot heb' t'a wib'anh.
Ha Dios tzak'anoch wuuj yik tzin sataneli, icha junok nok' chium nok'. Ay wal och sat t'ayin, icha wal to wajk'ool yaji.
Jantak heb' anima smolb'ej sb'a yik tzin sb'uchan heb'. Stz'itanb'at in sat heb', emnakil tzin yutejkan heb'.
Ha Dios ix in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh anima te chuk spensar.
Junk'olal wajeq'ui, ix in swekchitani. Ix och yub'naj t'a in jaj, chok' ix in yutej, ix in yak'anoch t'a sat sjul-lab'.
Yalnhej b'aj sjawi sjul-lab' chi' t'ayin, ichato sk'axpaj t'a in niwanil tik, manhxa jab'ok sniwank'olal t'ayin. Toxonhej spukkanb'at yol in k'ol t'a sat lu'um.
Jantak in aj in lajwi yuj. Skot wal t'ayin icha junok soldado te tek'an.
Te kusk'olal waji, ayoch pichul ya swa wuuj, manhxa jab'ok wopisio.
Ste mal in sat woq'ui, sq'uik'b'i k 'inal swila'.
Icha chi' waji, wach'chom malaj mach b'aj ix och in mul, wach'nhej in lesal.
Mokab' k'ub'chajel jantak chukal ix ak'jioch t'a wib'anh. Ab'chajokab'i ayik tzin tewi yik tzin k'anan tojolal.
Ay jun ayoch in testigook ayek' t'a satcha'anh, ha' ol och wet'ok.
Ha heb' wamigo tonhej tzin sb'uch heb', a inxo tik tzin ok'nhej t'a yichanh Dios.
Ayok wal junok mach tz'alan t'a Dios wuuj, icha syutej junok mach skolan junok yetanimail.
Jayexonhej ab'il ayin eq'ui, haxo in b'at t'a chamel chi' b'aj maxtzak yal ko paxta.
Jab'xonhej wal syal wik'an wik' swab'i. Wanxo sk'och in k 'inal t'a slajwub', wach'xo yaj wet'tal t'a kampusante.
Ha heb' anima, oyanoch heb' in sb'uchani, masanil tiempo syak' kus in k'ol heb', maxtzak yal in kolan in b'a t'a heb'.
Palta Mamin kolin, yujto malaj junokxo mach syak'och sb'a in skolani, a achnhej syal uuj.
Ha ach ix a k'ub'ejel jelanil t'a juntzanh heb' winh wamigo tik, manh in a cha ak'jok ganar yuj heb' winh.
Elokab'k'och icha syal jun ab'ix: Ha junok mach syixtej junok yamigo, haxo yuninal ol ab'an syail yuj jun tas sk'ulej chi'.
Ha ach ix ak' yal chuk heb' anima t'ayin, ix laj stzub'an in sat heb'.
Toxonhej k'ik'aminak wilan yuj in yaelal. Ichato manh chekelok in niwanil tik, yujto ix in te b'akb'i.
Ayik syilan heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al tas tzin ik'an tik, sat sk'ol heb', skot yowal heb', yujto chuk in snaan heb'.
Ha heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, wach'nhej ol elk'och heb'. Ha heb' malaj chukal sk'ulej, ol k'enhejchaanh heb'.
Palta kotanhek t'a tik ex wamigo. Malaj junok aj pensar tz'ilchaj wuj t'a he kal.
B'elb'on yek' in k 'inal, haxo tas nab'il wuuj, ma tas tzin nib'ej, toxo ix juwieli.
Ha ex tik a t'ak'walil tzeyaloch k'ualil, haxo yik k'ik'k 'inal, tzeyalani, lak'anxo ay sakil k'inal.
Toxonhej tzin tanhwej in chami, yik sk'och telan in niwanil sway t'a kal k'ik' k'inal.
Ha nok' ha'ay yet' kampusante swaloch in mam in nunok yet' wanab'ok.
¿B'ajtil ay tas swak'och yipok in k'ool? ¿Ay am mach ojtannak tas ol in ajok?
¿Tom ol k'och jun chi' wet' t'a yet'tal heb' chamnak? ¿Tom ol kannhej wet' ta' t'a yol lum lum chi'? xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Bildad icha tik:
¿B'aq'uinh wal ol aktej a loloni? Nachajokab' uuj, ichato pax chi' syal ko loloni.
¿Tas yuj tzonh al nok'al, manhxa jab'ok kelk'och t'a a sat?
¿Tas yuj tza chalchitej a b'a yuj chichonk'olal? ¿Am a naani yujto icha chi' tzutej a b'a ol kan tzinan lum lum tik, ma ol k'exwok yet'tal k'een tenam?
Ha tas ayoch yipok sk'ol junok mach chuk spensar, ol tupemok, icha stup junok candil wanxo stup sk'ak'al.
Ol tup sk'ak'al scandil t'a yol spat, manhxa sakil k'inal ta'.
Maxtzak yal yek' yet' stek'anil, wan slokan sb'a yok, stelwi yuj tas nab'il yuj.
Ichato ol em junok ch'anh yaal t'a yol sb'e, ol kan sut'naj t'a yol jun ch'anh yaal chi'.
Ol em jun ch'anh yaal chi' t'a yol sb'e. Ha t'a sjaj yok ol och sut'naj ch'anh.
k'ub'eltak yajem jun yaal chi' t'a yol sb'e.
Aynhejoch xiwk'olal t'a spatik yichanh, ichato spechji b'eyek'ok.
Ay tas t'ay t'a peka', haxo tiknaik wan scham yuj wejel, a yaelal k'elanxo och t'ay.
Ha jun ilya slajanel sniwanil, haxo sk'ab' yet' yok ichato ol k'uxjokb'at yuj jun ilya chi'.
Ol ik'jokel t'a skal junk'olal b'aj kajan, ol nherjokkanb'at t'a yichanh jun aj chamel.
Ch'okxo mach ol kajnajkan t'a skajnub'. Ayik toxo ix cham chi', ol tzikchajek' azufre t'a yol spat chi', yik satel jun yab'il chi'.
Lajan wal icha junok te te' takinhxo sch'anhal yib' yet' sk'ab'tak.
Ha sb'inajnakil ol satkanel t'a sat lu'um tik. Manhxa b'ak'uinh ol b'inajok.
Ol ik'chajel t'a skal heb' pitzan b'aj sakq'uinal. B'aj ay heb' chamnak t'a k'ik' k'inal ol yumjokkanb'atok.
Manhxa yinhtilal ol kan t'a schonhab' yet' b'aj kajan.
Ayik ol ab'chaj tas ix jawi t'a yib'anh, ol xiwkank'e heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u.
Icha wal chi' ol aj satel heb' chuk, haton heb' malaj yelk'och Dios t'ay, xchi winhaj Bildad chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
¿B'aq'uinh wal ol eyaktej he tzuntzan owaj in yaelal tik, tzeyak'an kus in k'ol yet' juntzanh he lolonel tik?
Ayexnhejoch eyalan chukal lolonel t'ayin. ¿Tom max ex q'uixwi eyalan t'ayin?
Q'uinalok yel ay in mul chi', ¿tom tzeyab' syail yuj?
Tzeyik' wal chaanh he b'a t'ayin yuj in yaelal tik, tzeyalanoch t'a in sat to chuk in.
Palta komonok snachajel eyuuj to ha Dios icha tik tzin utani. A' ix in ak'anem t'a yol jun yaal tik.
Skomon el waw, swalan icha tik: Swab' wal in chami, xin chi. Palta malaj mach stak'wi t'ayin. Tzin nib'ej ay mach tzin kolani, palta malaj mach sb'oan yaj t'ayin.
Ha Dios ix makan yol in b'e, yik maxtzak yal in b'eyeq'ui. Ichato t'a skal k'ik' k'inal tzin ek' yuj.
Ix yik'ek' in b'eyumal, ix yik'anek' sniwanil welk'ochi.
Ix in satem t'a junelnhej. Ha tas ayoch yipok in k'ool, pilan ix lajwiel icha junok te te' malaj sch'anhal yib'.
Ix sekkot yowal sk'ool t'a wib'anh, icha wal junok yajk'ool ix in yutej.
Masanil heb' soldado Dios chi' ix och hoyan t'ayin. Ix oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak in pat yik syak'an owal heb' wet'ok.
Ha Dios chi' ix ik'anel heb' wuk'tak yet' heb' wamigo t'a in tz'ey, ichaxonhej junok komon anima ix in yutejkan heb'.
Ha heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok yet' heb' wamigo, ix in yaktejkan heb', ix in b'atkan satk'olal yuj heb'.
Haxo heb' kajan t'a in pat yet' masanil heb' in chekab', icha junok ch'ok animail ix in ajkan t'a heb', maxtzak in yilochlaj heb'.
Tato swawtejkot junok heb' in chekab' chi', maxtzak tak'wilaj heb' t'ayin, wach'chom tzin tewi t'a heb'.
Ayik tzin k'och t'a stz'ey ix wetb'eyum, chuklaj sjab' xob'al in ti' syab' ix, haxo heb' ayto wuj in b'a yet'ok, tzin syajel heb'.
Icha pax chi' heb' unin tzin spatikejel heb'. Ayik syilan heb' weq'ui sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin.
Ha wal heb' ek'b'al te wach' wak'an yet'ok, tzin spatikejel heb'. Ha wal heb' tzin te tzalaj yet'ok, ix meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Toxo ix takjioch in tz'umal yet' in b'ak'chil t'a in b'akil, tewelxonhej pitzan in.
Ex wamigo, ok'okab' he k'ool t'ayin, yujto ha Dios ix ak'ankot jun yaelal tik t'a wib'anh.
¿Tas yuj tzak'anexnhej wuuj, icha tzin yutej Dios? ¿Tom manh k'okb'ilokxo in eyak'an kusok?
Ayok wal mach stz'ib'ankan juntzanh in lolonel tik. Komonok tz'ak'chajkanoch t'a k'een k'een.
Komonok a yet' k'een cincel nab'a hierro tz'ak'jikanoch t'a k'een k'een yik skan t'a junelnhej.
Wojtak to a in Kolumal pitzannhej, haxo t'a slajwub' k'ual ol emul t'a sat lum tik yik tzin skolani.
Wach'chom slajwiel in tz'umal tik, palta ol wil wal och Dios yet' in niwanil tik.
Ha in wal lak'an ol wil wal och yet' in sat, manh ch'okok mach ol ilanok. Wanxo slajwik'och wip swab'i.
Ayik swab'an eyalan icha tik: ¿Tas wal skutej kak'an kus sk'ol winh, yujto munil a winh tz'ik'ankot syaelal chi' t'a yib'anh? xe chi.
Palta xiwanhek t'a k'een espada, haton yowal sk'ol Dios syak'lab'ej t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ojtakejekeli to ay jun Dios tzonh ch'olb'itani, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Zofar aj Naamat icha tik:
Ach Job, maxtzak yal-laj to tonhej numan tzin aji. Yuj chi' tzin nib'ej tzin tak'wi t'ayach.
Ix onh a b'uch wal yet' a chukal lolonel, palta wojtak tas ol aj in pakan t'ayach.
Ha ach tik ojtaktaxoni to atax yik ix te q'uib'chaanh anima t'a sat lu'um tik,
a stzalajk'olal heb' chuk max najtilaxlaj. Junnhej rato syak' jab' stzalajk'olal heb' chi'.
Wach'chom te chaanh yajk'e heb' icha schaanhil satcha'anh, haxo sjolom heb' sk'ek'och b'aj ay asun,
palta ol lajwokem heb' icha stza' nok' nok', haxo heb' yamigo heb', manhxo ol nachaj yuj heb' b'aj ol k'ochkan heb' chuk chi'.
Ol satem heb' t'a ichnhej ta' icha junok wayich. Manhxalaj mach ol ilanoch heb'.
Ha heb' tz'ilantaxonoch heb' yet' heb' junnhej tzek' yet' heb', manhxa b'ak'uinh ol iljokoch heb' yuj heb'.
Ha tas yelk'ejnak heb', haxo heb' yuninal heb' ol ak'an meltzaj t'a heb' meb'a' b'aj yelk'ejnak heb' chi'.
Ayik tek'an wal yip heb' t'a skelemal, ol emkan heb' b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak.
Wach'chom te wach' sk'ulan chukal heb' syab'i, ste tzalaj heb' yet'ok,
te chi' jun chukal chi' t'a heb',
haxo t'a yol sk'ol heb', ol meltzajoch venenoal, icha svenenoal nok' chan.
Masanil sb'eyumal heb' ix sb'uk'emi, ol xejejxik'eta heb', yujto ha Dios ol ik'ank'eta t'a yol sk'ol heb' chi'.
Ichato ix stz'ub'b'at svenenoal nok' chan chi' heb'. Ha jun veneno chi' ol ik'an scham heb'.
Manhxo ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' jantak tas ay t'ay, haton lech, nok' yal chab' to manhxa yalnab'il.
Masanil tas yik'nakek' heb', yowalil ol yak'xi meltzaj heb'. Manhxo ol yal yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' sb'eyumal chi'.
Ix te ixtaj heb' meb'a' yuj heb', manhxa jab'ok tas ix kan t'a heb'. Ha heb' chuk chi' ix makank'e yikok juntzanh pat to manhoklaj heb' b'ojinak.
Manhxa jab'ok tas ix kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Haxonhej heb' smakb'ej sb'a t'ay smasanil, palta manh najtilok ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet'ok.
Ayik tzijtum tas tz'aj t'a heb', tzijtum pax kusk'olal ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha wal yik wan yak'an b'ut'jok sk'ol heb', syak'an snib'ej heb' yet' tastak ay t'ay, hata' ol sekkot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb'.
Tato ol yak' ganar heb' yel t'a k'een espada nab'a hierro, haxo jul-lab' nab'a bronce ol ek' t'a heb'.
Ha jun jul-lab' chi' ol k'axpajek' t'a sniwanil heb'. Ol ek' t'a seyub' heb', ol elk'och t'a yich spatik heb'. Ol te xiwk'e heb' yuj jun chi'.
Ha k'ik' k'inal ol k'ub'anel tastak sik'an yuj heb'. Ha jun k'ak' max tupi, ha' ol nhusantz'a masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
Ha Dios ol ak'an cheklaj schukal heb'. Ol yalanpax heb' anima to ay smul heb'.
Ayik ol jawok yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb', ol satel masanil sb'eyumal heb'.
Haton wal juntzanh tik nab'il yuj Dios t'a yib'anh heb' chuk chi', wach'xo yajkan t'a yib'anh heb' yuj, xchi winhaj Zofar chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Maklejek wal eyab' tas swala', tato icha chi' ol eyak' sniwanil in k'ool.
Niwan tzeyutej he k'ool yakb'an tzin loloni. Slajwi in lolon chi' tzex b'uchwajxi t'ayin b'ian.
¿Tokwal a yet' junok anima wan wak'an owal? ¿Tom manh smojok skus in k'ool he naani?
Ilineknab'i ol ex xiwb'atok, manhxalaj tas ol elta t'a he ti'.
Ayik tzin naankot juntzanh chi', tz'ib'xik'e in niwanil tik yuj xiwelal.
¿Tas yuj niwan tiempo syil heb' chuk? Sk'och heb' icham animail, sb'inaj wal heb'.
Tzato yil heb' sq'uib' yuninal, stzalaj pax heb' yoch hoyan heb' yixchikin t'a stz'ey.
Malaj tas xib'tan heb', junk'olalnhej yajek' heb'. Malaj syaelal heb' tz'ak'ji yuj Dios.
Ha nok' smam swakax heb', wach'nhej yel yinhtilal nok'. Ayik stajni nok' snun swakax heb', max ek'laj yune' nok'.
Ha yalyuninal heb' sk'e cheneljok heb' icha sk'e tz'itiljok nok' yunetak chiwa.
Ayik syab'an heb' yoch sjajil yamk'ab' yik b'it, haton te' arpa, te' tanhb'il yet' te' spukhaji, sk'e cheneljok heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Wach'nhej yaj heb' chuk chi', junk'olal tz'aj sb'atkan heb' b'aj smukchaji.
Syalan heb' t'a Dios: Manh onh a tzuntzej, max yal ko k'ol skojtakejel a cheknab'il.
¿Mach jun Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi', yik tzonh och ejmelal t'ay? ¿Tas skak' yala' tzonh tewi t'ay? xchi heb'.
Ha snaan heb' chuk chi' to yujnhej sjelanil heb' ay sb'eyumal heb'. Ha inxo tik max in cha wab' tas syal heb'.
¿Tom skomon cham heb' chuk icha tz'aj stup junok candil? ¿Tom skomon jawi yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'? ¿Tom skomon kot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb' syab'an syail heb' yuj?
¿Tom skomon saklemb'at heb' icha anh ak tz'ik'jib'at yuj chakxuxum ik'?
Ha eyalani to hato heb' uninab'il stupan smul smam. Palta a in tik swala' to smoj a wal lak'an heb' stupan smul chi', yik syojtakejel heb' to yuj smul heb' icha chi' tz'aj heb'.
Ha heb' chuk chi' smojton schaan yaelal heb' sjawi t'a yib'anh yuj yowal sk'ol Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil.
Ayik toxo ix cham heb', manhxalaj yalan yik heb' yuj tas skotkan t'a yib'anh yuninal heb' chi'.
Palta, ¿mach syal sk'ayb'an Dios t'a jelanil? Anhejton wal Dios chi' sch'olb'itan heb' te niwak yelk'ochi.
Ay heb' wach'nhej tz'aj yeq'ui, tek'an wal yip heb' scham heb'.
Ay pax heb' jun, te kusk'olalnhej tz'aj yek' heb' scham heb', malaj jab'ok tzalajk'olal syil heb'.
Palta jun, a b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak chi', lajannhej ol aj heb'. Junlajan ol chijokb'at heb' yuj nok' ha'ay.
Wojtak tas tze na t'a in patik yet' he chuk pensaril.
Tze naan icha tik: ¿B'ajtom ix kan spat jun winh chuk tik, jun winh yajalxo ix yutej sb'a tik? xe chi.
¿Tom malaj b'aj tzex lolon yet' heb' anima sb'eyeq'ui? ¿Tom maj eyab' tas syik'tiej heb'?
Ayik skot yowal sk'ol Dios, syak'ankot junok yaelal, haxo heb' chuk malaj tas tz'ik'an heb'.
¿Mach tz'alanoch t'a sat heb' yuj tastak sk'ulej chi'? ¿Mach ol ak'an spak yuj tas sk'ulej heb' chi'?
Haxo sb'at mukchajkan heb', stanhwaj b'aj smukchaj heb' chi'.
Siklab'inak lum lum sb'atkan t'a yib'anh heb'. Jantak heb' mukb'ilxo ta', jantakto pax heb' ol mukjokpaxok.
¿Tas tz'aj eyak'an sniwanil in k'ol yet' juntzanh he lolonel malaj yelk'och tik? Nab'a es juntzanh tzeyal tik t'ayin, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Elifaz aj Temán icha tik:
¿Tokwal ay tas ol yik' Dios t'a junok anima, wach'chom to aj pensar?
Q'uinalok te tojol tzutej a b'a, mato malaj a mul, ¿tom ay jab'ok tas ol yik' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'a a patik?
Manh yujok to tza k'anab'ajej, ma yuj a wach'il syak'an a kachnab'il yet' a yaelal Dios chi'.
Palta yujto a wal a chukal yet' a mul chi' malaj slajwub'.
Ix a k'ankanek' spichul heb' meb'a' ayik ix ak'an tas sk'ex heb', wach'chom ix elkan b'eran heb'.
Wach'chom te b'inajnak ach, to ik masanil lum lum tik, palta maj ak' jab'ok ha' yuk'ej heb' ay stakinhtial, maj ak' pax wa heb' ay swejel.
Ix a chek meltzaj heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, malaj jab'ok tas ix ak' t'a heb' ix. Ix ik'anek' tas aykan t'a heb' chamnak smam.
Yuj chi' tzoymaj chukal t'a a patik tiknaik, tzach somchajk'e yuj tas ay smay.
Ichato k'ik' k'inal yaj t'ayach, maxtzak yal ilan jab'ok. Icha wal to a junok ha' eluma' wan ach yik'anb'ati.
Ha Dios ay t'a satcha'anh, najat ayk'e t'a yib'anh k'een k'anal, syilemta masanil tastak tzuji.
¿Am a naani to max yil ko b'eyb'al? ¿Tom a k'ik'al asun tzach k'ub'anel t'ay?
¿Am a naani to yuj k'ik'al asun chi' max yil Dios, yakb'an wan sb'eyek' t'a yib'anh satcha'anh chi'?
¿Tom tza tek'b'ejnhej a b'a a b'eyb'alan sb'eyb'al heb' peka' anima chuk sb'eyb'al?
Pet chamnak heb' chi', icha tz'aj yik'jib'at junok mach yuj ha' eluma'.

Wach'chom ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil ix ak'an b'ut'jok spat heb' yuj masanil tastak, palta ix spatikejel Dios chi' heb'. Snaan heb' to malaj tas tz'utaj heb' yuj. Mokab' in na icha sna heb' pit syutej sb'a chi'.
Ayik ol yilan heb' wach' spensar satel heb' chuk, ol tzalajk'e heb'. Haxo heb' malaj smul tonhej ol tzewaj heb' ol yalan heb' icha tik:
Ha heb' kajk'ool wan satel heb', wan stz'ab'at sb'eyumal heb', xcham heb'.
Ach Job, ochanhxi junk'olal yet' Dios, tato icha chi' wach' ol ach ajxieq'ui.
Schaokab' a k'ol to ha Dios chi' tzach k'ayb'ani. Kanokab' wal slolonel t'a a pensar.
Tato tzik'em a b'a, tzak'anxioch a b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi', ol ach yik'xichaanh. Tato najat tzik'kanel chukal t'a a pat,
tato manhxa yelk'och k'een oro jantak swach'il t'a yol a sat, ichaxonhej lum pokok, ma k'een komon k'een ay t'a yoltak ha ha' tz'ajkan k'een t'ayach,
tato icha chi' tzutej a b'a, ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi' ol och a b'eyumalok, icha jantak k'een oro, ma k'een plata.
Ol ach tzalaj yet'ok, ol ak'paxoch yipok a k'ool.
Tato ay tas ol a k'an t'ay, ol yab' tas ol ala', a hachxo ol ak'elk'och b'aj ix ak' a ti' t'ay.
Ha tastak ol a na'a, ol elk'och t'ayach, yujto a swach'k'olal Dios ol ochnhej het'ok.
Ha Dios tz'ik'anem heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, skolwaj t'a heb' emnakil syutej sb'a.
Hanheja' skolan heb' malaj smul, ol ach skol paxi tato malaj a mul, xchi winhaj Elifaz chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ha tiknaik hanheja' yel waw yuj in yaelal tik. Wach'chom tzin te k'akwi, palta hanheja' yak'anoch in yaelal Dios.
Komonok swojtakejeli b'ajtil tz'ilchaj Dios chi' wuuj, tas pax tz'aj in k'och b'aj ay sdespacho.
Tato icha chi' tzam wal t'ay yuj in yaelal tik, yujto tzijtum tas tzin nib'ej swal t'ay yuj in kolan in b'a.
Tzin nib'ej swojtakejeli tas ol yal t'ayin.
¿Tokwal ol yak'lab'ej yip yik tzin skachanem numnajok? Maay, ol smaklej yab' tas ol wala'.
Ol am yojtakejeli to yel swala', ol am yalani to malaj in mul. Icham chi' ol aj in yak'anel t'a libre t'a junelnhej.
Tzin sayek' Dios t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, malaj ayek' ta'. Tzin saypaxek' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, max ilchajpaxlaj wuj ta'.
Tzin sayek' t'a stojolal norte, max ilchajlaj wuuj. Hanhejtona', tzin sayanxi t'a stojolal sur, max sch'ox pax sb'a t'ayin ta'.
Palta yojtak in b'eyb'al. Ayik ol lajwok in yak'an prowal, wach'xonhej ol in ajkan icha k'een oro sb'o t'a kal k'ak'.
Ha jun b'eyb'al ix sch'oxkan t'ayin, malaj b'ak'uinh swaktejkan in b'eyb'alani.
Tzin k'anab'ajejnhej scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al. Ek'b'alxo yelk'och scheknab'il chi' t'a yichanh b'eyumal t'a yol in sat.
Ayik snaan Dios sk'ulan junok tasi, sk'ulejnhej, malaj junok mach syal skachanoch waan.
Ha tas nab'il yuj sk'ulan t'ayin, sk'ulejnhej. Tzijtumto pax tas nab'il yuj t'a wib'anh.
Yuj wal chi' tzin te xiw t'ay. Anhej tzin naankoti tzin te xiwk'ei.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, yuj tz'el wip yuj xiwelal.
Wach'chom maxtzak wil-laj yuj k'ik' k'inal oyanoch t'a in patik, palta max in emlaj numan.
Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ¿tas yuj max yal sk'ual ayik sch'olb'itani, yik wach' stanhwaj yuj heb' swach'k'ol chi' t'a jun k'u chi'?
Ha heb' chuk sk'ex stz'akanhil lum lum heb', syelk'an nok' kalnel heb', syak'anoch nok' heb' t'a skal nok' yiko'.
Syik'anek' nok' sb'uru heb' meb'a' chamnak smam heb', sk'anankan nok' swakax heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum yuj k'een tumin syak' heb' majanil.
Tz'ik'jikanel heb' meb'a' t'a yoltak b'e yuj heb'. Haxo heb' anima emnakil yeq'ui, sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb' t'a heb' chuk chi'.
Ha heb' meb'a' chi' lajan tz'ajkan heb' icha nok' kaltakte'al b'uru t'a tzinan lu'um. Hata' say wa sb'a heb'. Ha t'a tzinan lum chi' say swael yalyuninal heb'.

Ha heb' meb'a' chi' sb'at heb' t'a smunlajel heb' ch'ok animail. Sb'at sik'k'e ixim jolom trigo heb', sb'at pax heb' t'a skal yawb'en uwa heb' chuk chi', sb'at heb' say te' sat tzato kani ayik smolji.
Ha heb' meb'a' chi', malaj spichul heb' ayochi tzek' ak'wal. Malaj jab'ok tas spichan heb' t'a siik.
Ayik syak'an nhab', tzek'chaj ha' t'a heb' t'a kaltak te', haxo t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een skol sb'a heb'.
Ha heb' chuk chi' syik'ek' snenetak unin heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum heb', yik skan t'a heb' yuj tas syak' heb' majanil t'a heb' ix.
Ha heb' meb'a' chi', jab'tzin spichul heb' ayochi. Tz'ek' heb' kuchoj trigo, palta wan schampax heb' yuj wejel.
Smunlaj heb' yet' k'een molino tz'ik'anelta aceite. Stek'anel yal sat te' uwa heb', palta wan schampax heb' yuj takinhtial.
Haxo heb' ya yaji, tz'el yaw heb' sk'anan kolwal. Wan scham heb' t'a kal chonhab', palta max ab'chajlaj yel yaw heb' yuj Dios.
Ay heb' malaj snib'ej t'a jun b'e yik sakil k'inal, max sb'eyb'alej tojolal heb'.
Ayik k'ik'to sk'e waan heb' mak'umcham anima, yik sb'at smak'ancham heb' meb'a' heb'. Haxo tzek' ak'wal, a elk'al syak' heb'.
Ha heb' tz'em ajmulal stanhwej heb' sq'uik'b'i, smakan sat heb'. Snaan heb' icha tik: Malaj mach ol onh ilanochok, xchi heb'.
Ha heb' elk'um chi', a t'ak'walil tz'och heb' elk'al t'a te' pat. Haxo t'a k'ualil makan heb', yujto max schalaj sk'ol sakil k'inal heb'.
Xiw heb' t'a sakil k'inal chi', haxo k'ik' k'inal stzalaj heb' yet'ok, yujto hata' xiw juntzanhxo anima.
Ha heb' chuk chi', elanhchamelnhej ol ek' heb' icha sb'ey swomal ha ha', haxo sluum heb' ol katab'ajkanok. Manhxa mach ol munlaj b'aj ay yawb'en uwa heb'.
Icha tz'aj yulaxb'at k'een cheew yuj sk'ak'al yok k'u, icha chi' ol aj satem heb' chuk chi' b'aj smukchaji.
Ha heb' chuk chi' sb'atkan heb' satk'olal yuj snun. Manhxa mach snaankot heb', haxo nok' ha'ay schianb'at heb'. Stelwi heb' icha tz'aj stelwi junok te te' sch'akchaji.
Tz'ixtaj heb' ix ix toxon max unewilaj yuj heb'. Max kolwajpaxlaj heb' t'a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Palta ha Dios yet' spoder satanel heb' chuk chi'. Ha wal yik sch'oxan spoder Dios chi', manhxa junok mach max xiw t'a chamel.
Tato tz'el t'a sk'ol Dios, junk'olal pitzan heb' chuk chi', palta aynhejoch sat t'a tas sk'ulej heb'.
Kennhej tiempo tz'ik'jichaanh heb' chuk chi', palta elanhchamel satxikanel heb'. Icha tz'aj stakji ixim trigo jochb'ilxo, icha chi' tz'aj heb'.
Tato manh ichokta', ¿mach ex syal eyalani to wan wesani, to satnak in? xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Bildad aj Súa icha tik:
Ha Dios ay spoder, xiwub'tak, a tz'ak'anoch junk'olal t'a skal heb' ay t'a satcha'anh.
Manhxo b'ischajb'enok jantak k'een k'anal b'ob'il yuj, ¿tom ay junok mach b'aj max k'och sakil k'inal yuj?
¿Tokwal ay junok anima malaj smul t'a yichanh Dios? ¿Tokwal ay junok mach te wach'?
Ha k'een uj malaj yok k'een t'a yichanh. Haxo k'een k'anal manh wach'ok k'een t'a yol sat.
Okxo wal onh anima onh tik, lajan onh icha nok' ha'ay, xchi winhaj Bildad chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Yipk'olal ix kolwaj a lolonel ix al t'ayin t'a in kusk'olal tik, yuj am to tzila' to manhxalaj wip.
Wach' jun, syal ak'an in razón, tzin a k'ayb'an a in malaj in pensar tik.
¿Mach ix lolon t'a a pensar yuj chi' tzala'? ¿Mach ix halan t'ayach, yuj chi' tzal icha chi'?
Ha heb' chamnak ayek' t'a sjulal yich ha' mar, tz'ib'xi heb' yuj xiwelal.
Ha b'aj ayek' heb' chamnak, chekel yaj t'a yichanh Dios, chekel yaj junjun heb' t'a yichanh.
Ha ix jenhb'anb'at satcha'anh t'a stojolal norte b'aj jakan, malaj tas t'ay. Ix sb'oanoch lum lum b'aj malaj tasi.
Ha tz'ak'anb'at ha ha' t'a skal asun, palta max nhik'chajlaj asun chi' yuj yalil ha'.
Ha tz'ak'an k'ik'b'okel sat k'een uj, wach'chom k'ojan k'een, palta ha' tz'ak'anoch asun t'a sat k'een.
Ha ix ak'anem yechel t'a yib'anh ha' mar b'aj sk'och k'aman sakil k'inal yet' k'ik' k'inal.
Ha yipumal satcha'anh tz'ib'xi, xiwpaxk'ei ayik stumwaj Dios chi'.
Ha yuj spoder ix skachanoch waan ha' mar, yuj sjelanil ix yak'an ganar nok' niwan Rahab.
Jun pusnhej syak'a' sk'achwi, a yet' spoder stekancham nok' chan mekan kuman sb'ati.
Ha jantak tas satub'tak sk'ulej ix kab' tik, jab'nhej. Ha tas ix kab' tik tonhej ix ko mak ab'ej. Okxom wal to tz'akan tz'aj kab'ani, maxtzak am nachajel kuuj, xchi winhaj Job chi'.
Ix lolonnhej winhaj Job:
Swak' in ti' t'a yichanh Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, haton jun max yal sk'ol sb'oan yaj tas waji, haton tz'ak'an ixtaxel in pensar yuj in yaelal,
yakb'an pitzan hinto, yakb'an tzato yal wik'an wik' yuj, anhej tas yel ol wala', manh ol wal tas manh yelok.
Toxon malaj b'ak'uinh ol wala' to yel tas tzeyal t'ayin. Manh ol in chaoch t'a wib'anh to ay in mul.
Ol walnhej to wach' in pensar, manh ol in k'ex tas swala'. Tzin b'eyk'olej wal in b'a to malaj in mul swab'i.
Masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, jaokab' yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', icha yaelal sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' chuk.
¿Tasto wal ayoch yipok sk'ol heb' chuk, ayik tz'ik'jiel sk'inal heb' yuj Dios?
Ayik ayoch heb' t'a syaelal, ¿tom ol scha yab' Dios ayik ol tewok heb' t'ay?
¿Tokwal tz'ilchaj stzalajk'olal heb' t'a Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil tato malaj b'aj syal sb'a heb' t'ay?
Ha tiknaik ol in ch'ox wal sniwan poder Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'ayex yet' tas nab'il yuj.
Ha ex tik eyilnakxo juntzanh chi', haxo tiknaik jun, ¿tas yuj tzex lolon t'a manh pensaril?
Ha jun yaelal tik syak' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil spakok t'a heb' ixtum anima.
Wach'chom tzijtum yuninal heb', palta ol cham heb' t'a owal, ma yuj wejel.
Haxo heb' olto kan t'a skal heb', a ilya ol ik'an scham heb'. Haxo heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' skani, manh ol ok'laj heb' ix yuj heb'.
Wach'chom a heb' chuk chi' ste molb'ej k'een plata heb' icha lum pokok, wach'chom manh jantakok spichul heb' ayeq'ui,
axom junok winh winak te wach' spensar ol ak'anoch juntzanh pichul chi', ol yak'an snib'ej winh yet' k'een plata chi'.
Ha spat heb' chuk chi', k'uun, lajan icha juntzanh yet'tal nok' tzokoy, ma icha junok lechpat t'a kal munlajel.
Ha heb' chuk chi' swaykanem heb' yet' sb'eyumal, haxo tz'el swayanh heb' manhxalaj tas t'a heb', mheb'axo heb'.
Ha xiwelal ol jawok t'a heb' icha ha' eluma', ma icha tz'aj yik'jib'at junok tas yuj ik'nhab' t'ak'walil.
Ha chakxuxum ik' skot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, a ol ek' leman spat heb',
ol och xuman t'a heb', ol lajwokel heb' yuj. Wach'chom olto snib'ej el lemnaj sb'a heb', palta manhxalaj niwank'olal t'a heb'.
Ha jun owal ik' chi' ol k'anh wal, ol xururok yoch t'a spatik heb'.
Ha k'een plata ay sminasil k'een b'aj sk'eta, haxo k'een oro ay yet'tal k'een b'aj sb'oi.
Ha k'een hierro tz'ik'chajk'eta k'een t'a yol lu'um, haxo k'een k'een, ayik stz'a k'een t'a kal k'ak', tz'elta k'een cobre t'a k'een.
Ha heb' anima, maxtzak xiwlaj heb' b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal. Tz'emnhej heb' t'a yoltak k'een niwak xab' te jul yich. Ha t'a skal k'ik' k'inal chi', hata' say k'een k'een chi' heb'.
Sjoyk'eta juntzanh minas heb' b'aj maxtzak ek' anima, najat yajb'at b'aj ay chonhab'. Ha yet' ch'anh lasu tzek' t'unhunhok heb'.
Ha t'a sat lu'um tik, sq'uib'chaanh tas swaji, haxo t'a yalanh lu'um syak'och k'ak' heb' anima yik spoj k'een k'een.
Haxo t'a skal sk'ajil k'een chi', tz'ilchaj k'een zafiro yet' k'een oro.
Ha t'a yoltak minas chi', malaj junok nok' ik'umb'at much tzek' ta'. Malaj pax nok' ch'akb'a tz'ilan yool chi'.
Ha nok' chium nok', maxtzak ek'laj nok' ta'. Maxtzak ek'paxlaj nok' choj ta'.
Ha heb' winh winak, smak' k'een k'een heb' winh te tzatz, syamanoch heb' winh sjoyan yichtak lum niwak witz.
Sjoyanoch niwak olan heb' winh t'a sattak k'een tenam, yik sayan k'een k'een heb' winh karo stojol.
Sjakank'eta ha ha' heb' winh ta'. Syik'ank'eta heb' winh t'a sakil k'inal tastak k'ub'eltak yaji.
Palta a jelanil ¿b'ajtil tz'ilchaji? ¿b'ajtil ay aj pensaril?
Ha jelanil chi' malaj junok anima ojtannak tastak yet'nak, max chaxlaj t'a skal heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Wach'chom sko sayek' t'a sjulal yich ha' mar, max chaxlaj kuj ta'.
Max yal yak'chaj k'een oro, ma k'een plata sk'exulok.
Max yal smanchaj yet' k'een oro te wach', ma yet' k'een kornalina, ma yet' k'een zafiro.
Max yal ko lajb'an yet' k'een oro, ma yet' k'een k'een karo stojol. Max yal sk'exchaj yet' yelwanub' sk'an heb' ix ix nab'a oro.
Ha jelanil chi' te nib'ab'il t'a yichanh k'een coral. Ek'b'al te wach' t'a yichanh k'een cuarzo, ma k'een perla.
Max yal slajb'an sb'a jelanil chi' yet' k'een crisólito skot t'a Etiopía, max yal stupchaj yet' k'een oro te wach'.
Palta ¿b'ajtil skot jelanil chi'? ¿b'ajtil ay aj pensaril?
k'ub'ab'ilel t'a masanil anima pitzan. k'ub'ab'ilpaxel t'a nok' much sjenhwi.
Ha b'aj ayek' heb' chamnak yet' jun chamel, syal heb' icha tik: Tonhej ix kab' sb'inajnakil jelanil chi', xchi heb'.
Palta ha Dios yojtak sb'eal jelanil chi', yojtak b'aj ay.
Yujto syil masanil b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' masanil tas ay t'a yalanh satcha'anh.
Ayik ix yak'ankanoch Dios yipal ik', ayik ix yak'anem yechel b'aj sjawi k'aman ha ha',
ayik ix sb'oankan tiempoal nhab'ilq'uinal, ayik ix sb'oankan b'aj tzek' lheb'lon yik smak'waj k'u,
hata' ix yila' to te niwan yelk'och jelanil, ix sch'olb'itani, ix yilani to wach' tz'aj icha chi'.
Ix yalan Dios t'a heb' anima icha tik: Tato niwan welk'och t'a yol he sat, haton jelanil chi', tato tzeyik'el he b'a t'a skal chukal, haton aj pensaril chi', xchi Dios chi'.
Ix syamanxioch winhaj Job yalan icha tik:
Komonok wal syal in k'ochxi icha wajtaxon t'a yalanhtaxo ayik te tanhwab'il in yuj Dios.
Ayik syak'an sakil k'inal Dios t'ayin, wach' in ek' t'a kal k'ik' k'inal,
tek'an anima in, chekel wal skolwaj Dios yet' tastak ay t'ayin.
Aynhejek' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi' wet'ok, haxo heb' wuninal, oyanoch heb' t'a in patik.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', manhxo jantakok yal yim nok' in wakax yet' nok' in chiwa tz'elta. Ha te' olivo awab'il t'a kaltak k'een, manh jantakok aceite swik' t'a te'.
Ayik tzin k'och b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' yajalil chonhab', tzin em k'ojan t'a in xila t'a skal heb'.
Ayik tzin yilan heb' kelemtak, sb'es sb'a heb', haxo heb' ichamtak winak sk'e linhan heb' ayik tzin k'ochi.
Ha heb' yajal chonhab', numan tz'aj heb', syak' yechel heb' yik numan tz'aj juntzanhxo heb'.
Ha heb' yajalil chonhab', k'unxonhej slolon heb', manhxa tas syal heb'.
Ayik tzin yilan heb', syab'an heb' tas swala', syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a in patik,
yujto tzin kolwaj t'a heb' manhxa smam yet' t'a heb' meb'a', haton heb' malaj junokxo mach skolan t'a skal yaelal.
Ha heb' wan scham yuj mheb'ail, syak' yuj diosal heb' t'ayin, haxo heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum, stzalaj heb' ix yuj in kolwal.
Ha tojolal yet' wach'k'olal aynhejoch t'ayin, ichato in pichul yajochi.
In och yet' heb' max uji yilani yet' heb' max uji sb'eyi.
Icha mamab'il waj t'a heb' ay stzapan smajanil. Tzin kolan pax heb' max yal skolan sb'a t'a yichanh heb' yajal, wach'chom manh wojtakok heb' palta tzin kolnhej heb'.
Swik'el yopisio heb' ixtum anima, tzin kolankanel heb' ayoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.
Ha in naani to te niwan tiempo ol wila'', icham animail ol ik'an in cham t'a in ch'at.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' lajan in icha junok te te' awab'il t'a sti' junok ha ha', a sk'ab'tak te' schaan yal ak'wal tz'emi.
Wach' syutej heb' anima in yak'an b'inajok, ichato junjun k'u tz'ochnhej wip in kolan in b'a.
Masanil anima smaklan yab' tas swala', numan tz'aj heb' yab'an in razón.
Ayik slajwi in lolon chi', schanhej sk'ol heb' smasanil. Wach'nhej syab' heb'.
Snib'ej wal heb' syab' in lolonel chi', icha wal snib'an nhab' heb' munlajwum t'a waresma.
Ayik tzin tzewaj yet' heb', tz'och k'elan heb', ijan wal max schalaj heb', max stzuntzejkotlaj wowal heb'.
Swak'och wopisio t'a skal heb', swalani tas yowalil sk'ulej heb', icha junok rey tz'ak'an mandar t'a skal heb' soldado. Ayik ay skusk'olal heb', swak' sniwanil sk'ool heb'.
Ha heb' kelemtak te tzak'anto t'ayin, tzin stzetzej heb' tiknaik, okxo t'a yalanhtaxo, a heb' smam heb' manh smojok yek' heb' yet' nok' in tz'i' stanhwan nok' in kalnel.
Toxonton malaj yip heb', malaj tz'och heb' wuuj.
Yuj wejel yet' mheb'ail, tzek' heb' t'a takinh lu'um t'ak'walil sch'okoj, haxo sch'anhal yib'tak te te' sjoyk'eta heb' sk'uxu'.
Slaj stok'k'eta anh komon ank'ultak heb' t'a kaltak te' schi'a, schi'an pax sch'anhal yib' te' meslab' heb'.
Haton juntzanh anima chi' pechb'ilel yuj heb' yetanimail. Ayik spechjib'at heb' chi', tz'el yaw heb' spechanb'at heb' chi', icha tz'aj spechji heb' elk'um.
Ha t'a yoltak k'een nhak'een, t'a sattak k'akap yet' t'a sattak k'een tenam, hata' ix laj aj heb'.
Slaj awaj heb' t'a kaltak wayumtak icha yel yaw nok' nok', haxo t'a yichtak yok te' q'uiix slaj smolb'ej sb'a heb'.
Malaj jab'ok tas syal yuj heb', malaj yelk'och heb', pechb'ilel heb' t'a skal heb' anima.
Haxo tiknaik tzin sb'uch heb' yuninal heb', syik'anel in q'uixwelal heb'.
Tzin syajan heb', tz'el heb' t'a in tz'ey, stzub'anoch heb' t'a in sat.
Palta a tiknaik, ha Dios ix ik'anel wip, maxtzak yal in kolan in b'a, yuj chi' syak' wal snib'ej heb' in yixtani.
Ha heb' anima schichon sk'ol t'ayin, toxonhej sja nhilan heb' yik tzin spechanel heb' snaani, snib'ej heb' tzin sateli.
Smakan yol in b'e heb' yik tzin satanel heb' snaani, manhxa mach skachan heb'.
Sjawi nhilnaj heb' t'ayin, ichato ay junok olan b'aj tz'ochta nhilnaj heb', ma icha ko yamchaj yuj junok ik' nhab'.
Icha wal chi' tz'aj sjawi xiwk'olal t'ayin. Ha in b'inajnakil ix sateli, ichato ix ik'jib'at yuj ik'. Masanil tas ay t'ayin ix satkanel icha asun.
Ha tiknaik wan in chami, maxtzak och waan in yaelal tik.
Ha in yaelal tik sk'och wal t'a yoltak in b'akil. Max och waan wab'an syail tzek' ak'wal.
Yet' wal yip Dios ichato ix sch'umoch sut'an in pichul t'a in jaj, ix och b'iran t'a in niwanil.
Ix in sjulem t'a kal sok'om. Icha lum pokok, ma k'een tik'aq'uil taanh in ajkan t'a yol sat.
Ach in Diosal, tzin k'an a kolwal, palta max ach tak'wi t'ayin. Tzin tewi t'ayach palta maxtzak a cha ab'i.
Chuk tzutej a b'a t'ayin, tzin a pechan yet' yowal a k'ool.
Ichato tzin ik'jik'e waan yuj ik', haxo ik' nhab' tzin tzikub'tanhani.
Wojtakxo to wanxo in ik'anb'at t'a chamel, haton b'aj ol k'ochnhej masanil anima.
Palta ¿tokwal max k'e ch'ikan sk'ab' junok mach ayek' t'a skal syaelal yik sk'anan kolwal?
In ok' yuj heb' ayoch t'a syaelal, in kus yuj heb' malaj tas ay t'ay.
Palta haxo tiknaik ayik tzin tanhwan tzalajk'olal, haxo kusk'olal sjawi t'ayin. Tzin tanhwej sakil k'inal, haxo k'ik' k'inal sjawi.
Toxonhej stinhtinhan in pixan yuj xiwelal, maxtzak yal wik'an jab'ok wip, haxonhej yaelal ste ja t'a wib'anh.
Ix ja wal kusk'olal t'ayin, maxtzak wil-laj sakil k'inal. Wal t'a yichanh anima tzin k'e waan in k'anan kolwal.
Kuseltakxonhej yel waw icha nok' okes, ma icha nok' kujub'.
Ha in tz'umal ix te k'ik'b'ieli, schiwajpax in niwanil yuj k'ak'.
Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, tzin b'itan wal yet' yamk'ab' yik b'it t'a tzalajk'olal, haxo tiknaik, anhej ok'el swak'a'.
In nanak sik'lab'il to malaj b'ak'uinh swiloch in k'ol t'a heb' ix kob'estak.
Q'uinalok swiloch in k'ol t'a heb' ix, ¿tokwal manh ol yak' spak Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil t'ayin?
¿Tom manhok t'a heb' chuk yet' t'a heb' b'aj malaj yelk'och Dios sjawi yaelal?
¿Tokwal max yil Dios tas tzin k'ulej yet' b'ajtak tzin eq'ui?
Swak' wal in ti' to malaj mach b'aj chuk swutej in b'a, malaj b'aj ek'nak t'a in k'ol in musan sat anima.
Komonok tzin sch'olb'itej Dios t'a stojolal icha yechtaj yalil junok tas, yik syilani to tz'akan in wach'il.
Q'uinalok in el t'a b'eyb'al yik tojolal, mato in nib'ejnak in k'ulej tas swilochi, mato ay tas manh wikok in maknak wikok,
tato icha chi', ch'okokab' mach slajankanel sat wawb'en, sjoyokab'k'eta heb' tas awab'il chi' wuuj.
Q'uinalok ay junok ix ix, ix kuchb'anb'at in pensar, mato in maklej yelta junok ix yetb'eyum junokxo winak t'a sti' spat,
tato icha chi', ak'jokab' serwil junok ch'ok winakil yuj ix wetb'eyum, wayokab' junok ch'ok winakil yet' ix.
Q'uinalok in k'ulej juntzanh chi', smoj wal wab'an syaelal tz'ak'jioch t'a wib'anh yuj heb' juez.
Tato icha chi', jaokab' in yaelal. Icha junok niwan k'ak' satanel tastak, ichaokab' ta' tz'aj satanel tastak ay t'ayin.
Ayik stek'b'an sb'a heb' in chekab' yalan t'ayin yuj tas swutej, swab' tas syal heb' chi'.
Tato manh ichaokta ix in k'ulej, ¿tas ol wutej woch t'a yichanh Dios? ¿Tas ol wutej walani ayik ol sk'anb'an t'ayin yuj tas ix in k'ulej?
Junnhej Dios onh ak'an pitzwok t'a ko nun yet' heb' in chekab' chi', hanhejtona' tz'ak'an ko k 'inal.
Manh tonhejok swiloch heb' meb'a' ay stzapan majanil, manh tonhejok swilpaxi to malaj tas swa heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Ayik in wa'i laj wak' yik heb' meb'a' unin wet'ok.
Icha wal wuninal swutej heb' meb'a' unin chi'. In kolwajnhej t'a heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum.
Ayik swilani to ay heb' anima te meb'a' malaj spichul ayochi,
haxo xil nok' in kalnel swak' b'ojok, swak'anoch sq'uixinalok heb'. Yuj chi' syak' yuj diosal heb' t'ayin.
Tato ay b'aj ix wixtej junok meb'a' unin yujto wojtak to chab'il wik yuj heb' yajal,
mak'jokab'el in k'ab' tik, elokab' weknaj in jenhjab' tik.
Yujto tzin xiw yak'an in yaelal Dios, yuj chi' max yal in tek'b'an in b'a t'a yichanh, yujto te niwan yelk'ochi.
Malaj b'aj anhej t'a niwak b'eyumal swak'och in pensar, maj wak'och k'een oro yipok in k'ool.
Malaj b'aj wik'nakchaanh in b'a yuj in b'eyumal, ma yuj jantak tas ay t'ayin.
Swil skopopial yok k'u yet' pax yik k'ojan k'een uj te wach' yilji,
palta malaj b'aj elk'altak tzin tz'ub'elta in k'ab' yik tzin ch'oxan yechel to tzin tz'ub'elta sti' k'u yet' k'een uj chi' yik swak'anem in b'a t'ay.
Q'uinalok icha chi' swutej in b'a, smoj am wal tz'ak'jioch in yaelal, yujto chab'sat am swutej in b'a t'a Dios ay t'a satcha'anh.
Malaj b'aj in tzalaj yuj yaelal sjawi t'a yib'anh heb' wajk'ool, ma yik sjawi chukal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Malaj b'aj ochnak in mul in k'anankot katab' t'a yib'anh heb', yik scham heb'.
Masanil heb' ayek' wet'ok, yojtak wal heb' to ayik sjawi heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'ayin, malaj junok heb' maj ak'ji tas swa'a.
Ha heb' anima sb'eyeq'ui, maj yal in k'ol skan heb' t'a yoltak calle t'ak'walil, jakannhej in pat t'a heb'.
Malaj in mul syal in k'ub'aneli, icha syutej sb'a juntzanhxo heb'. Malaj in mul elk'altak yaji,
yujto tzin xiw t'a heb' anima, talaj chuk tas syal heb' t'ayin. Maj in makoch in b'a t'a yol in pat yujto in xiw yuj tas syal heb' in k'ab' wok.

Komonok ay mach tz'ab'an tas swal tik. Ha juntzanh swal tik yelnhej smasanil. Haxo tiknaik tzin tanhwej tas spak ol ak'jok t'ayin yuj Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil chi'. Ha tas tz'ak'jioch t'a wib'anh chi', komonok wach' yaj stz'ib'chaj yuj winh tz'ak'anoch t'a wib'anh chi'.
Tato icha chi', tzam wak'k'e b'aj tz'ib'ab'iloch chi' t'a sjolom in jenhjab', ma t'a in jolom icha junok corona yik swik'anchaanh in b'a.
Tzam wal t'a Dios yuj masanil tas ix in k'ulej, max am in q'uixwi in k'och t'a yichanh.
Q'uinalok tonhej in tok'nakek' lum lum t'a heb' ay yiko', haton lum b'aj tzin munlaji,
q'uinalok tonhej ix in wab'at sat tas b'aj ix munlaj heb' in munlajwum, maj in tuppaxlaj heb', a na wan scham heb' yuj wejel.
Tato icha chi', q'uib'okab' te q'uiix t'a sat in lum chi' sk'exulok ixim trigo, haxo anh komon ank'ultak sq'uib' sk'exulok ixim cebada, xchi winhaj Job chi'. Haton slajwub' slolonel winhaj Job tik.
Ayik ix yilan heb' winh oxwanh chi' to stek'b'ej sb'a winhaj Job yalani to malaj smul winh, ix yaktan heb' winh stelan sb'a yet' winh.

Palta ha t'a skal heb' winh ay jun winh winak aj chonhab' Buz, Eliú sb'i winh, yuninal winh winhaj Baraquel yinhtilal winhaj Ram. Majxo techaj yuj winh skot yowal t'a winhaj Job chi', yujto stek'b'ej sb'a winh yalani to malaj smul winh, syak'ankanb'at winh t'a yib'anh Dios.

Ix kot pax yowal winhaj Eliú chi' t'a oxwanh heb' winh yamigo winhaj Job chi', yujto maj nachajel yuj heb' winh tas ix aj spakan slolonel winh heb' winh, wach'chom ix yak'kan heb' winh t'a yib'anh winh.
Ha winhaj Eliú chi' kelemto winh t'a skal heb' winh chi', yuj chi' ix stanhwej winh slolon juntzanhxo heb' winh chi' yet' winhaj Job chi'.
